source_en: The constant value for measurement ███ has been adjusted to 3.7426, showing a significant deviation from the previous constant value of 7.6587.
new_translation_vi: Giá trị hằng số cho phép đo ███ đã được điều chỉnh thành 3,7426, cho thấy sự sai lệch đáng kể so với giá trị hằng số trước đó là 7,6587.

source_en: This is the ███th observation on Tacet Field HL-057, conducted by 11371A Automated Observation Machine.
new_translation_vi: Đây là lần quan sát thứ ███ tại Tacet Field HL-057, được thực hiện bởi Máy Quan Sát Tự Động 11371A.

source_en: Retrieving visual environment...
new_translation_vi: Đang truy xuất môi trường hình ảnh...

source_en:
"With top-notch strength, plasticity, toughness, and corrosion resistance, this low-density, lightweight material can adjust its magnetic and electrical properties with temperature changes and has an extremely high melting point..."
Principal Investigator Xiangli Yao's prosthetic arm has sparked widespread discussion among researchers, who all agree that it is made from "a perfect material." It can not only transform swiftly but also perform as effectively as standard tools in practical applications.
new_translation_vi: "Với độ bền, độ dẻo, độ dai và khả năng chống corrosion hàng đầu, vật liệu nhẹ, mật độ thấp này có thể điều chỉnh các đặc tính từ tính và điện theo sự thay đổi nhiệt độ và có điểm nóng chảy cực cao..."

source_en:
"Waters and mountains rest by the pane, valleys and peaks in the dream remain. Colors of vanity washed away; the painted world fades, forgotten today."
Upon arriving in Jinzhou, Zhezhi resided in Xiehua Village for a while. Inspired by the scenery outside her window, she captured it in a painting.
new_translation_vi: "Nước và núi tựa bên khung cửa, thung lũng và đỉnh cao vẫn còn trong giấc mơ. Màu sắc của hư vinh đã rửa trôi; thế giới sơn vẽ phai nhạt, bị lãng quên hôm nay."

source_en:
Once in a moment of despair, Sanhua witnessed a golden snowfall, dazzling like petals cascading from the heavens.
Drawn to the sight, she forgot her pain and predicament.
Only later did she realize they were actually fallen Bodhi blossoms.
To this day, that ethereal scene enchants her dreams, where swirling snow transforms into a golden deluge of petals. These dreams bring her solace, giving her the strength to face her anomalous visions with calm determination.
new_translation_vi: Trong một khoảnh khắc tuyệt vọng, Sanhua đã chứng kiến một trận tuyết vàng, rực rỡ như những cánh hoa rơi từ thiên đường.

source_en:
In Jinzhou, Mortefi is the creative force behind 80% of popular children's toys and entertainment facilities. From the Spinning Bloop to the Swinging Loongboat and the Sabyrboar Scooter, his designs always captivate young minds. Surprisingly, he doesn't charge any patent fees for these designs. 

For Mortefi, it's not about money; it's about seeing the joy, wonder, and admiration in children's eyes. 

Or perhaps, it's a way for him to recapture his own lost childhood.
new_translation_vi: Tại Jinzhou, Mortefi là lực lượng sáng tạo đằng sau 80% đồ chơi trẻ em và các cơ sở giải trí phổ biến. Từ Spinning Bloop đến Swinging Loongboat và Sabyrboar Scooter, các thiết kế của anh luôn thu hút tâm trí trẻ thơ. Đáng ngạc nhiên là anh không tính bất kỳ khoản phí bản quyền nào cho những thiết kế này.

source_en:
Ali, a classmate of Chixia's, once described to her how poignant their migration was: a time marked by relentless disruptions from the Tacet Discords, when hunger forced them to eat grass or tree bark. Yet, Chixia also remembers savoring this green grass cake, always roasted crusty and seasoned with spicy sauce. It remains a delightful treat etched in her memory.
When she asked her mother about their journey to Jinzhou after school, her mother playfully responded that it was a story open to Chixia's imagination.
new_translation_vi: Ali, một người bạn cùng lớp của Chixia, đã từng mô tả với cô về cuộc di cư đầy đau thương của họ: một thời kỳ bị đánh dấu bởi những gián đoạn không ngừng từ Tacet Discords, khi cơn đói buộc họ phải ăn cỏ hoặc vỏ cây. Tuy nhiên, Chixia cũng nhớ việc thưởng thức món bánh cỏ xanh này, luôn được nướng giòn và tẩm gia vị cay. Nó vẫn là một món ăn thú vị khắc sâu trong ký ức của cô.

source_en: The foe, nearing its complete form, views this as the most potent weapon, which relentlessly sows seeds of destruction and awakens humanity's primal fear of war.
new_translation_vi: Kẻ thù, đang tiến gần đến hình dạng hoàn chỉnh, coi đây là vũ khí mạnh nhất, không ngừng gieo rắc hạt giống hủy diệt và đánh thức nỗi sợ hãi nguyên thủy của nhân loại về chiến tranh.

source_en: Yinlin is accustomed to walking in shadows, much like the threads of lightning in her hand. These threads silently ensnare her prey, delivering an unexpected fatal blow. With the charge gathered at her fingertips, she metes out punishment to those who deserve it. Once the myriad threads are lifted, everything in her grasp becomes nothing more than lifeless puppets.
new_translation_vi: Yinlin đã quen với việc bước đi trong bóng tối, giống như những sợi sét trong tay cô. Những sợi dây này lặng lẽ bẫy con mồi, tung ra một đòn chí mạng bất ngờ. Với điện tích tích tụ trên đầu ngón tay, cô trừng phạt những kẻ xứng đáng. Một khi vô số sợi dây được nâng lên, mọi thứ trong tầm tay cô không còn gì khác ngoài những con rối vô hồn.

source_en: An artist for hire trying to make a living. Reserved and timid, she is not good with words but speaks volumes through her art, where her creations come to life with impossible authenticity.
new_translation_vi: Một nghệ sĩ làm thuê đang cố gắng kiếm sống. Kín đáo và nhút nhát, cô không giỏi ăn nói nhưng lại thể hiện rất nhiều qua nghệ thuật của mình, nơi các tác phẩm của cô trở nên sống động với sự chân thực không thể tin được.

source_en: A set of paintbrushes Zhezhi purchased during her first solo shopping trip as a child, after fumbling for words in front of the shop owner. Wherever Zhezhi went, so did these paintbrushes, recording her artistic growth along the way. Though now too old and fragile to use, Zhezhi still regards them as a source of encouragement, handling them with great care.
new_translation_vi: Một bộ cọ vẽ mà Zhezhi đã mua trong chuyến đi mua sắm một mình đầu tiên khi còn nhỏ, sau khi lúng túng trước chủ cửa hàng. Bất cứ nơi nào Zhezhi đi, những chiếc cọ vẽ này cũng đi theo, ghi lại sự phát triển nghệ thuật của cô trên đường đi. Mặc dù giờ đã quá cũ và dễ vỡ để sử dụng, Zhezhi vẫn coi chúng là nguồn động viên, xử lý chúng rất cẩn thận.

source_en: New desserts, art exhibit tickets, trips to new cities... Struggling to pay off her family's debt while barely making ends meet, Zhezhi took the habit of jotting down things she wanted to buy or do on a wish list. She often checks this list, but can only fulfill one or two of these smaller wishes on rare occasions when she has a bit of extra money.
new_translation_vi: Món tráng miệng mới, vé triển lãm nghệ thuật, những chuyến đi đến các thành phố mới... Phải vật lộn để trả nợ cho gia đình trong khi khó khăn lắm mới kiếm đủ sống, Zhezhi đã có thói quen ghi lại những thứ cô muốn mua hoặc làm vào danh sách mong muốn. Cô thường kiểm tra danh sách này, nhưng chỉ có thể thực hiện một hoặc hai trong số những mong muốn nhỏ hơn này vào những dịp hiếm hoi khi cô có thêm một chút tiền.

source_en:
A puzzle crafted from intricately interlocking joints, a testament to its ingenious design. It is said that such trinkets served as gifts from elder members of the Court of Savantae to their younger generations.

Xiangli Yao can still recall the warmth of his father's rough fingertips as he handed him the puzzle on his birthday. Yet what truly captivated him were its complex arrangements and perplexing structures—such puzzles were what drew him into a world of intricate logic, leaving him spellbound for years to come.

This was Xiangli Yao's first encounter with a puzzle, but certainly not his last.
new_translation_vi: Một câu đố được chế tác từ các khớp nối lồng vào nhau phức tạp, minh chứng cho thiết kế khéo léo của nó. Người ta nói rằng những món đồ chơi như vậy là quà tặng từ các thành viên lớn tuổi của Court of Savantae cho thế hệ trẻ của họ.

source_en:
The girl proudly presented her painting to her mother, eager to share her achievement. The woman, absorbed in selecting jewelry to wear, stole a fleeting glance at the artwork. "Impressive, Zhezhi," she murmured with a brief smile. Delighted by the praise, the girl inched closer. "The people in this one are—" Her words faltered as her mother turned, absorbed in wardrobe choices, oblivious to her daughter's attempt at connection. "Well done. Now, why don't you paint a few more before the guests arrive?" Zhezhi blinked, at a loss for words. Her mother grew impatient, sighing as she marched Zhezhi to the door. "Buy whatever supplies you need, dear. The price doesn't matter, we can afford it. Now, I need to dress. Be a good girl. Off you go." As the door closed, Zhezhi stared at it, wanting to say more but unable to find the courage to voice the sinking feeling in her chest.

Later that evening, Zhezhi, dressed to impress, nervously clutched her skirt in the corner seat, silent amidst the bustling room of guests. The woman noted Zhezhi's unease, the sight of it triggering memories of their family's past struggles and humble beginnings. She strode forward, taking Zhezhi's hand and leading her into the center of attention. "Didn't you know? Zhezhi was gifted from the day she was born. Her paintings were chosen for exhibitions even before we hired a tutor." With a painted smile, she mimicked the grace of the upper class. "Would you care for a painting too? Zhezhi can finish one in a day." Zhezhi shrank inwardly, wishing to disappear, only to be thrust forward. "Show everyone your skills, Zhezhi." All eyes turned to her, leaving Zhezhi trembling, unable to paint a single stroke.

Later, as the mansion fell silent, Zhezhi gathered her courage again. Holding the day's painting, she approached her parents' bedroom door. Just before knocking, she overheard their conversation inside.
"Did you know? That painting sold for 400,000 Credits today. With this money, we can fulfill the paused order."
"Right. Are the paintings for the guests ready for this weekend?"
"Not yet. Zhezhi mentioned wanting to go to the theater. That girl, always seeking diversions, never thinking about what's best for this family..."

Zhezhi looked down at the happy family in the painting, her grip tightening until it crumpled, distorting her mother and father's faces.
"...I'm sorry."
new_translation_vi: Cô gái tự hào trình bày bức tranh của mình với mẹ, háo hức chia sẻ thành tích của mình. Người phụ nữ, mải mê chọn đồ trang sức để đeo, liếc nhìn thoáng qua tác phẩm nghệ thuật. "Ấn tượng đấy, Zhezhi," bà lẩm bẩm với một nụ cười ngắn ngủi. Vui mừng vì lời khen ngợi, cô gái tiến lại gần hơn. "Những người trong bức tranh này là—" Lời nói của cô ngập ngừng khi mẹ cô quay đi, mải mê với việc chọn trang phục, không hề hay biết về nỗ lực kết nối của con gái mình. "Làm tốt lắm. Bây giờ, tại sao con không vẽ thêm vài bức nữa trước khi khách đến?" Zhezhi chớp mắt, không biết nói gì. Mẹ cô trở nên thiếu kiên nhẫn, thở dài khi bà đẩy Zhezhi ra cửa. "Mua bất cứ vật dụng nào con cần, cưng à. Giá cả không quan trọng, chúng ta có thể chi trả được. Bây giờ, mẹ cần phải ăn mặc. Hãy là một cô bé ngoan. Đi đi." Khi cánh cửa đóng lại, Zhezhi nhìn chằm chằm vào nó, muốn nói thêm nhưng không đủ can đảm để thốt lên cảm giác chìm xuống trong lồng ngực.

source_en:
Zhezhi realized something was amiss in her painting only after heading out for a sketch. As she took in the idyllic countryside, a new idea struck her like a ray of sunlight. Glancing around to make sure she was alone, she stretched her arms, and for a moment, let go of her parents' demands.

As her bare feet met the grass, its prickly, cool softness awakened a sense of nature's healing vitality. She broke into an impulsive run, shedding worries about upholding the refined image her family demanded. A distant voice abruptly interrupted her frolic.

"Hey, who are you? What are you doing in our field?"

Startled, Zhezhi immediately looked down at her feet in embarrassment. Realizing she was trespassing on private property, she apologized as she tried to leave. "I'm so sorry! I came here to paint. I didn't know this was someone's field..."

The girl laughed, seeing the panic on Zhezhi's face. "Don't worry! These veggies are tough. You don't need to run!" She laughed as she continued gathering the vegetables with her sickle. "A painter, huh? That's different..." Zhezhi hesitated for a moment, seeing the girl hard at work. "Let me help you with that..." The girl met Zhezhi's eyes with a twinkle. "Sure! Thanks for offerin'! Here, use this sickle, I'll go grab another one!"

Zhezhi stared in confusion at the sickle promptly shoved into her hands. But she soon squatted down among the tall vegetables, mimicking the farm girl's movements. "Wait, wait. You won't get anywhere doin' it like that. Here, lemme show ya!"

Under the hot sun, the two girls worked together to harvest the field until they reached its end. Exhausted, they lay under a tree to rest. Zhezhi forgot about the mud on her shoes and the dirt on her expensive dress, lost in the joy of spending time with her new friend. The carefree laughter between them filled her heart with ease and brought a true smile to her lips.

The mood was suddenly cut by a sharp voice. Zhezhi turned to see her mother watching, her eyes squinted in anger. Zhezhi could see her disdain for her new friend. Sprinting to her feet, she ran to explain and apologize, transforming back into the child her parents demanded she be.

A few days later, the girl received a scroll. She unrolled it carefully, gasping softly at the sight. The painting showed her and Zhezhi in the sprawling fields of her home, picking vegetables together.

A letter fell from the painting.

"I'm sorry I didn't say goodbye. I had so much fun harvesting the field with you! The sickle, the sun beating down on us, my sore hands... It made me realize what my paintings were missing. This is my best work, and it's for you! I hope you like it! Maybe next week, I can sneak out to help again."

Reading the letter made the girl smile, but she couldn't help being confused by Zhezhi's last line.

Next week? Did she think the vegetables would grow back that fast?
new_translation_vi: Zhezhi nhận ra có điều gì đó không ổn trong bức tranh của mình chỉ sau khi ra ngoài để phác thảo. Khi cô đắm mình vào vùng nông thôn bình dị, một ý tưởng mới ập đến như một tia nắng. Nhìn quanh để đảm bảo mình chỉ có một mình, cô vươn vai, và trong một khoảnh khắc, buông bỏ những yêu cầu của cha mẹ.

source_en:
Unsuspecting, Zhezhi was thrown out of her home, her belongings strewn across the courtyard like discarded memories. As she gazed at the mess, it dawned on her that she herself was just another discarded item, abandoned by her parents like the rest.

Desperate for shelter, she first sought out places familiar to her. But those once kind and welcoming turned cold when they learned of her plight. Behind their polite excuses, Zhezhi saw the distaste in their eyes as they pointed her to an old hotel on a street corner.

The hotel's decaying corridors teemed with unfamiliar fights and loud arguments. Sitting on the bed, she wrapped herself tightly in the musty covers, eyes fixed on the flimsy wooden door barricaded by a table. She longed for sleep, hoping to wake from this nightmare, yet fear kept her awake, afraid the door would shatter if she closed her eyes.

Her descent from luxury to hardship stretched endlessly, each day a painful reminder. The staggering figures of her parents' debt seemed to flicker across the ceiling in the dim light of her windowless room. Her hands, covered in worn bandages, trembled from painting non-stop for two days, but she dared not rest.

"It's a big order... I can't mess this up," she murmured, her weary eyes blurring the landscapes on her canvas.

Suddenly, harsh shouts pierced the night, jarring her awake from an unintended nap at her desk. She stumbled to the door, slipping on something wet at her feet.

Aching from the fall, she stood nervously at the door of her leaking room, apologizing repeatedly to her neighbors. The biting cold seeped through her wet clothes, and the neighbors' complaints echoed through the thin walls. She stared at her painting, ruined by the water, and a heavy sigh escaped her lips, compressing the room's thin air, almost crushing her fragile frame.

Zhezhi's exhausted figure stood motionless in the cold puddle. After a long pause, a faint light glowed in the cramped room. With paint-stained fingertips, she scrolled through her Terminal, "First, shut off the water valve... then replace the damaged parts..."

She had made a habit of looking up solutions for life's unexpected challenges. 

"I think I've got it... I'll give it a try..."

She waded through the water, slowly making her way to the source of the problem.
new_translation_vi: Không nghi ngờ gì, Zhezhi bị đuổi khỏi nhà, đồ đạc của cô vương vãi khắp sân như những ký ức bị vứt bỏ. Khi cô nhìn vào đống hỗn độn, cô nhận ra rằng chính cô cũng chỉ là một món đồ bị vứt bỏ khác, bị cha mẹ bỏ rơi như những thứ còn lại.

source_en:
"This painting is a reflection of me. Everyone needs to see at first glance that it's an expensive masterpiece."

"If this is the best you can do, I'll take it. But only at half the price."

The client's words echoed in Zhezhi's mind. She wandered the streets with her bundle of paintings, feeling a sense of numbness begin to creep over her as the festive preparations around her started to fade into the background. It wasn't until she tripped, her paintings scattering, that she snapped out of her daze. Without bothering to look for her glasses, at first she scrambled to pick up her work. But as the wind blew some paintings out of reach, she stopped, staring for a moment before deciding to let them go.

"Forget it, they're lousy anyway... What's the point of having them back..."

She dropped the remaining paintings in her arms, letting them fall. Lost in her thoughts, she didn't notice someone stopping in front of her.

A stranger picked up her paintings and glasses, handing them back to her.

"Did you paint these? I've never seen art like that. Remarkable."

Zhezhi, stunned by the compliment, could only accept the outstretched paintings and watch the stranger turn and leave alongside their companions, disappearing into the night.

She fumbled to put on her glasses to catch a clearer glimpse of who it was, but all she caught was a distant silhouette.

"Someone complimented me... "
"They had nothing to gain from it. It was just... simple praise for my paintings."

The stranger's words, simple yet sincere, pierced through her paintings to reach her heart. For the first time ever, it was as if someone saw her creative intentions. It was like a sudden beam of light scattering the dark clouds that had long weighed her down, bringing a sense of warmth long overdue.

Zhezhi stared in the direction the stranger had vanished, clutching her paintings tightly. Until...

"Excuse me... Hello?"

Days later, a familiar voice startled her out of her thoughts as she searched for the perfect spot to paint.

"Don't worry, we're just here to chat."

Zhezhi looked up and saw a pair of golden eyes. The memory of that night rushed back—this was the person who had complimented her work, their voice free of the pretense she had grown to despise from everyone else. That voice had given her strength when she had been ready to give it all up.

The warmth from that night returned, filling a world of pale grey with color once more.
new_translation_vi: "Bức tranh này là sự phản chiếu của tôi. Mọi người cần phải thấy ngay từ cái nhìn đầu tiên rằng đó là một kiệt tác đắt giá."

source_en: So many paintings... Ah, not that I'm complaining about the commissions! It's just, I keep finding new things that inspire me... Oh, sorry. What I wanted to say is, the sunlight on you right now is so beautiful. Can I... paint you?
new_translation_vi: Nhiều bức tranh quá... À, không phải tôi phàn nàn về các đơn đặt hàng đâu! Chỉ là, tôi cứ tìm thấy những điều mới truyền cảm hứng cho mình... Ồ, xin lỗi. Điều tôi muốn nói là, ánh nắng trên người bạn lúc này thật đẹp. Tôi có thể... vẽ bạn không?

source_en: I-I saved half of a lemon cake for you. Want to try it? I couldn't help myself and bought it with some of the money I saved up, as a celebration for finishing my commission. I've wanted it for so long! It's sweet but not too rich, with perfect layers. It tastes just as amazing as I imagined!
new_translation_vi: T-Tôi đã để dành một nửa chiếc bánh chanh cho bạn. Bạn muốn thử không? Tôi không thể kiềm chế được và đã mua nó bằng một phần số tiền tôi tiết kiệm được, như một lễ kỷ niệm cho việc hoàn thành đơn hàng của mình. Tôi đã muốn nó từ rất lâu rồi! Nó ngọt nhưng không quá ngậy, với các lớp hoàn hảo. Nó ngon như tôi tưởng tượng!

source_en: You mean those phantasms? They're just illusions. They might look vibrant and stunning, but... they're not real. I prefer a flawed reality over a perfect illusion. Even though it's tough and unpredictable, it also has its surprises, like... meeting you.
new_translation_vi: Bạn có ý nói những ảo ảnh đó sao? Chúng chỉ là ảo ảnh thôi. Chúng có thể trông rực rỡ và tuyệt đẹp, nhưng... chúng không thật. Tôi thích một thực tại đầy khiếm khuyết hơn là một ảo ảnh hoàn hảo. Mặc dù nó khó khăn và khó đoán, nhưng nó cũng có những bất ngờ, như là... gặp bạn.

source_en: Do you ever feel lonely when you're alone? I do enjoy my own company, but after a while, I start wishing I had someone to talk to. But... whenever I try, I never know what to say and I'm afraid of saying the wrong thing, so it usually ends up awkward... But talking to you feels different. It's like a conversation I used to only dream about. I really wish we could talk like this... forever.
new_translation_vi: Do you ever feel lonely when you're alone? I do enjoy my own company, but after a while, I start wishing I had someone to talk to. But... whenever I try, I never know what to say and I'm afraid of saying the wrong thing, so it usually ends up awkward... But talking to you feels different. It's like a conversation I used to only dream about. I really wish we could talk like this... forever.

source_en: You know, I started a portrait of you a while ago, but I haven't finished it yet… I feel like I can't capture everything I feel for you on just one piece of paper. If it's alright, I'd like to show it gradually, through what I do and say.
new_translation_vi: You know, I started a portrait of you a while ago, but I haven't finished it yet… I feel like I can't capture everything I feel for you on just one piece of paper. If it's alright, I'd like to show it gradually, through what I do and say.

source_en: When I cook, it feels like the flavors never blend, like the ingredients and seasonings are at odds… Are-are you interested in tasting it? Um, I'll have to practice more before you try it…
new_translation_vi: When I cook, it feels like the flavors never blend, like the ingredients and seasonings are at odds… Are-are you interested in tasting it? Um, I'll have to practice more before you try it…

source_en: This brush is called Miaohua. It reacts to phantasms. When I was younger, I had trouble controlling my ability, and sometimes I couldn't tell reality from illusion… The worst time, I was trapped in an illusion for two whole days without realizing it. It was Miaohua's reaction that made me realize everything around me was fake and helped me find my way back to reality.
new_translation_vi: This brush is called Miaohua. It reacts to phantasms. When I was younger, I had trouble controlling my ability, and sometimes I couldn't tell reality from illusion… The worst time, I was trapped in an illusion for two whole days without realizing it. It was Miaohua's reaction that made me realize everything around me was fake and helped me find my way back to reality.

source_en: If your living space feels cramped, try using furniture in a single color. If prices seem unfair, try going right before the shop closes to find a good deal... I've realized that since I can't change everything, changing my perspective can really help... it's helped me find little bits of happiness in life!
new_translation_vi: If your living space feels cramped, try using furniture in a single color. If prices seem unfair, try going right before the shop closes to find a good deal... I've realized that since I can't change everything, changing my perspective can really help... it's helped me find little bits of happiness in life!

source_en: She's got a real knack for appraising antiques, and knows all about where the rare old paintings are kept. If she hadn't told me where to find those friendly collectors, I'd never have gotten to see the originals with my own eyes. Though she's never told me how she gets her info, I can tell it's not easy. So now and then, I slip some money into her pocket when she's not looking!
new_translation_vi: She's got a real knack for appraising antiques, and knows all about where the rare old paintings are kept. If she hadn't told me where to find those friendly collectors, I'd never have gotten to see the originals with my own eyes. Though she's never told me how she gets her info, I can tell it's not easy. So now and then, I slip some money into her pocket when she's not looking!

source_en: Oh! She once invited me to dinner, and I said yes. However, when I arrived at the restaurant, it turned out to be a large gathering with dozens of people… I was quite nervous, but she was super nice, always making sure I was okay. Thanks to that, I actually met a lot of new people... and some of them even became my clients later on.
new_translation_vi: Oh! She once invited me to dinner, and I said yes. However, when I arrived at the restaurant, it turned out to be a large gathering with dozens of people… I was quite nervous, but she was super nice, always making sure I was okay. Thanks to that, I actually met a lot of new people... and some of them even became my clients later on.

source_en: It's your birthday today. I-I know there will be many people celebrating and giving you gifts, so... I'm not sure what to get that won't be repetitive… How-how about you tell me what you want? Anything you want, I can find it, or any place you wanna go, I'll come along. If you haven't decided yet, that's okay too! My offer will never expire. Really, anytime you need something, just ask and I'll do my best. Oops, sorry, I-I'm rambling... I meant to say, happy birthday!
new_translation_vi: It's your birthday today. I-I know there will be many people celebrating and giving you gifts, so... I'm not sure what to get that won't be repetitive… How-how about you tell me what you want? Anything you want, I can find it, or any place you wanna go, I'll come along. If you haven't decided yet, that's okay too! My offer will never expire. Really, anytime you need something, just ask and I'll do my best. Oops, sorry, I-I'm rambling... I meant to say, happy birthday!

source_en: I'm Zhezhi… I do commissioned paintings. Um, what else...? Oh, I'm open for commissions! I offer fair prices, can adapt to any style you need, and do revisions too. And I never miss a deadline!
new_translation_vi: I'm Zhezhi… I do commissioned paintings. Um, what else...? Oh, I'm open for commissions! I offer fair prices, can adapt to any style you need, and do revisions too. And I never miss a deadline!

source_en: Th-thank you! Sorry if I've been a bother... Please make sure to take care of yourself before helping me. I wouldn't know what to do with this power if something happened to you... But please, know how much I cherish y—Er, I mean, know how much I cherish your help!
new_translation_vi: Th-thank you! Sorry if I've been a bother... Please make sure to take care of yourself before helping me. I wouldn't know what to do with this power if something happened to you... But please, know how much I cherish y—Er, I mean, know how much I cherish your help!

source_en: As the child of two scholars, I was always drawn to the same path. Perhaps trying to follow in their footsteps. However, my recollections of them have blurred over time. Most of what I know about my parents comes from reading their published research and evaluations of their work by others, rather than personal memories. Their existence feels elusive to me, like a hazy dream. Yet, I am their legacy—a reflection of their brilliance, and... their madness.
new_translation_vi: As the child of two scholars, I was always drawn to the same path. Perhaps trying to follow in their footsteps. However, my recollections of them have blurred over time. Most of what I know about my parents comes from reading their published research and evaluations of their work by others, rather than personal memories. Their existence feels elusive to me, like a hazy dream. Yet, I am their legacy—a reflection of their brilliance, and... their madness.

source_en: I like interacting with people, be it my colleagues at the Academy, or others. At times, I fear losing sight of my own humanity while chasing truth's elusive grasp... In those moments, I step away and seek solace in a bustling crowd. The laughter on their faces reminds me of the warmth of human connection.
new_translation_vi: I like interacting with people, be it my colleagues at the Academy, or others. At times, I fear losing sight of my own humanity while chasing truth's elusive grasp... In those moments, I step away and seek solace in a bustling crowd. The laughter on their faces reminds me of the warmth of human connection.

source_en: Losing my arm didn't bring as much pain as I expected. I was too consumed with excitement, finally discovering the Court of Savantae Ruins, following in my father's footsteps. The achievements I witnessed were beyond imagination. The secrets of a hidden civilization were revealed to me, their inventions harnessing the universe's echoes.
new_translation_vi: Losing my arm didn't bring as much pain as I expected. I was too consumed with excitement, finally discovering the Court of Savantae Ruins, following in my father's footsteps. The achievements I witnessed were beyond imagination. The secrets of a hidden civilization were revealed to me, their inventions harnessing the universe's echoes.

source_en: ...Ah, it's you. Please, come in. No need to worry, I just need to recharge after all those meetings. Like a machine needing a break. Hmm? So you would like to help? Sure, please sit here. Just... stay next to me for a while. You don't need to say anything. Yes, this will do. Thank you.
new_translation_vi: ...Ah, it's you. Please, come in. No need to worry, I just need to recharge after all those meetings. Like a machine needing a break. Hmm? So you would like to help? Sure, please sit here. Just... stay next to me for a while. You don't need to say anything. Yes, this will do. Thank you.

source_en: Writing a report alone, after completing research, is satisfying. My scattered thoughts and inspirations come together during this time, becoming clear and organized.
new_translation_vi: Writing a report alone, after completing research, is satisfying. My scattered thoughts and inspirations come together during this time, becoming clear and organized.

source_en: During back-to-back academic conferences, my focus wanes and I need time to recharge. Being with peers is enjoyable, but a little solitude is necessary for me to stay sharp.
new_translation_vi: During back-to-back academic conferences, my focus wanes and I need time to recharge. Being with peers is enjoyable, but a little solitude is necessary for me to stay sharp.

source_en: I love all breakfast foods. I prefer to sleep and wake up early instead of staying up late and consuming caffeine. Eating consistent breakfast portions energizes my mind quickly.
new_translation_vi: I love all breakfast foods. I prefer to sleep and wake up early instead of staying up late and consuming caffeine. Eating consistent breakfast portions energizes my mind quickly.

source_en: Oh, the Sour Soy Milk… When I was a toddler, my mother once convinced me to try it. While most of my childhood memories are joyful, that particular taste was overwhelming for my young palate.
new_translation_vi: Oh, the Sour Soy Milk… When I was a toddler, my mother once convinced me to try it. While most of my childhood memories are joyful, that particular taste was overwhelming for my young palate.

source_en: This prosthetic arm is pretty handy, loaded with helpful features. I don't have to worry about any arm injury while working on risky experiments, and I can even pull a few pranks on my colleagues. Oh, you want examples? Well... I'll definitely show you when I get the chance.
new_translation_vi: This prosthetic arm is pretty handy, loaded with helpful features. I don't have to worry about any arm injury while working on risky experiments, and I can even pull a few pranks on my colleagues. Oh, you want examples? Well... I'll definitely show you when I get the chance.

source_en: Among the friends I made when I was a kid, Pascar was the one who kept in touch with me for the longest time. Certain actions, when done too late, can lead to lingering regrets. Occasionally, I contemplate how each individual is a complex enigma, similar to the countless scientific theses I have studied.
new_translation_vi: Among the friends I made when I was a kid, Pascar was the one who kept in touch with me for the longest time. Certain actions, when done too late, can lead to lingering regrets. Occasionally, I contemplate how each individual is a complex enigma, similar to the countless scientific theses I have studied.

source_en: Mortefi is an interesting person. He's devoted to his work with unwavering determination. It's that kind of intense drive that pushes scientists towards brilliant discoveries. I know he considers me a "genius"—but in a workplace with only "geniuses", many ideas will never be realized. My dear friend has yet to grasp his true potential.
new_translation_vi: Mortefi is an interesting person. He's devoted to his work with unwavering determination. It's that kind of intense drive that pushes scientists towards brilliant discoveries. I know he considers me a "genius"—but in a workplace with only "geniuses", many ideas will never be realized. My dear friend has yet to grasp his true potential.

source_en: Baizhi is a great researcher. Our work doesn't often overlap, but I've read her reports and they're well-informed and persuasive. She often participates in field research, earning her a reputation among peers for bringing back valuable data.
new_translation_vi: Baizhi is a great researcher. Our work doesn't often overlap, but I've read her reports and they're well-informed and persuasive. She often participates in field research, earning her a reputation among peers for bringing back valuable data.

source_en: I can now achieve even greater things with Metalmorph. Is there a particular thing you desire? Please let me offer my new creation as a gift. It wouldn't exist without you.
new_translation_vi: I can now achieve even greater things with Metalmorph. Is there a particular thing you desire? Please let me offer my new creation as a gift. It wouldn't exist without you.

source_en: It's interesting. Your feedback reminds me of the texts I found in the Court of Savantae Ruins. Their ideology is fascinating and enigmatic, almost as if it came from the stars in outer space.
new_translation_vi: It's interesting. Your feedback reminds me of the texts I found in the Court of Savantae Ruins. Their ideology is fascinating and enigmatic, almost as if it came from the stars in outer space.

source_en: I'm headed to test the new combat techniques I've learned. Care to join me? It's time to put theory into practice. I believe I have reached a critical point, and overcoming it will bring a new horizon.
new_translation_vi: I'm headed to test the new combat techniques I've learned. Care to join me? It's time to put theory into practice. I believe I have reached a critical point, and overcoming it will bring a new horizon.

source_en: The pursuit of truth is a rocky path to tread. Some stumble and push forward, others lament their weariness, and a few may even turn back. Our ranks thin as we near the ultimate goal. But Rover... Though you blaze your own trail, I know you are always with us, guiding the truthseekers forward.
new_translation_vi: The pursuit of truth is a rocky path to tread. Some stumble and push forward, others lament their weariness, and a few may even turn back. Our ranks thin as we near the ultimate goal. But Rover... Though you blaze your own trail, I know you are always with us, guiding the truthseekers forward.

source_en: <<< Is that... the Waveworn phenomenon? Xiangli Yao, I...
new_translation_vi: <<< Is that... the Waveworn phenomenon? Xiangli Yao, I...

source_en: <<< I still can't accept it. If the incorrect theory was because of my own lack of ability, that would almost be a relief. But now...
new_translation_vi: <<< I still can't accept it. If the incorrect theory was because of my own lack of ability, that would almost be a relief. But now...

source_en: <<< No... Your wishes, my wishes... I will carry them to the destination we've all been longing for.
new_translation_vi: <<< No... Your wishes, my wishes... I will carry them to the destination we've all been longing for.

source_en:
A unique Tacet Discord. This Gulpuff is born from anomalous data, possessing an enormous size and terrifying destructive power. 

While Gulpuffs are generally regarded as Common Class Tacet Discords, this one has acquired exceptional combat ability and a violent temper due to the influence of anomalous data. Maintaining a safe distance is advised.
new_translation_vi:
A unique Tacet Discord. This Gulpuff is born from anomalous data, possessing an enormous size and terrifying destructive power. 

While Gulpuffs are generally regarded as Common Class Tacet Discords, this one has acquired exceptional combat ability and a violent temper due to the influence of anomalous data. Maintaining a safe distance is advised.

source_en:
Unique cluster of Tacet Discords. A swarm of Cruisewings bunched together due to anomalous data, exhibiting a certain extent of teamwork.

While individual Cruisewings are weak, their combined forces can create a powerful storm.

This swarm possesses formidable combat abilities that should not be underestimated.

Unique cluster of Tacet Discords. A swarm of Cruisewings bunched together due to anomalous data, exhibiting a certain extent of teamwork.

While individual Cruisewings are weak, their combined forces can create a powerful storm.

This swarm possesses formidable combat abilities that should not be underestimated.

source_en:
A unique Tacet Discord. This Fusion Warrior is born from anomalous data, possessing combat skills beyond imagination.

Its dual-wielded blades, replacing its arms, appear almost sentient, exploiting every weakness in an opponent's stance.

The specific frequency it mimicked to achieve such mastery in swordsmanship remains a mystery.

source_en:
A unique Tacet Discord. This Rocksteady Guardian is born from anomalous data, capable of smashing through multiple rock layers with a single blow. 

Despite its slow movement speed, its devastating force is more than enough to make up for it.

Brute force, pure and simple.

source_en:
Unique group of Tacet Discords. Two Tambourinists are fused together due to anomalous data, possessing frequencies of unimaginable intensity.

The sounds of their musical instruments are like the wails and resentments from the abyss—so haunting that merely hearing them might bring misfortune.
new_translation_vi:
Unique group of Tacet Discords. Two Tambourinists are fused together due to anomalous data, possessing frequencies of unimaginable intensity.

The sounds of their musical instruments are like the wails and resentments from the abyss—so haunting that merely hearing them might bring misfortune.

source_en: Your story begins in Jinzhou. Yet recent mysteries lead you on a path towards an archipelago shrouded in fog—the Black Shores. Perhaps these solitary shores will mark the End of Wandering for you...
new_translation_vi: Your story begins in Jinzhou. Yet recent mysteries lead you on a path towards an archipelago shrouded in fog—the Black Shores. Perhaps these solitary shores will mark the End of Wandering for you...

source_en: The Black Shores rests itself on an isle veiled in dense sea fog—a safe haven for countless Consultants and Bloom Bearers wandering the world. Without an invitation from its members, none has ever been able to locate this floating ark that connects the world in the vast ocean...
new_translation_vi: The Black Shores rests itself on an isle veiled in dense sea fog—a safe haven for countless Consultants and Bloom Bearers wandering the world. Without an invitation from its members, none has ever been able to locate this floating ark that connects the world in the vast ocean...

source_en: The upper and lower realms of the Black Shores are distinct yet interconnected, much like day and night. Beneath the sea's surface, the Black Shores' underground expanse stretches out as a city shrouded in perpetual darkness. Here, guided by their studies of the stars, Solaris' observers and modulators tirelessly search for the path to salvation...
new_translation_vi: The upper and lower realms of the Black Shores are distinct yet interconnected, much like day and night. Beneath the sea's surface, the Black Shores' underground expanse stretches out as a city shrouded in perpetual darkness. Here, guided by their studies of the stars, Solaris' observers and modulators tirelessly search for the path to salvation...

source_en: I had pictured our reunion in my head, again and again, after your departure. I wondered what kind of person you would become, how your days were spent, and if you achieved your goals. Countless questions filled my mind, but when I saw you again, there was only one thing I wanted to say: Welcome back. Back to the Black Shores, and… back to my side.
new_translation_vi: I had pictured our reunion in my head, again and again, after your departure. I wondered what kind of person you would become, how your days were spent, and if you achieved your goals. Countless questions filled my mind, but when I saw you again, there was only one thing I wanted to say: Welcome back. Quay lại to the Black Shores, and… back to my side.

source_en: Your past... I promised to keep it a secret, at your own request. That day, I realized our reunion would be one-sided. This is why your memory loss didn't surprise me... But it doesn't matter now. You may have forgotten me, but I will remember everything about you, always.
new_translation_vi: Quá khứ của bạn... Tôi đã hứa sẽ giữ bí mật theo yêu cầu của bạn. Ngày hôm đó, tôi nhận ra cuộc hội ngộ của chúng ta sẽ chỉ đến từ một phía. Đó là lý do tại sao việc bạn mất trí nhớ không làm tôi ngạc nhiên... Nhưng giờ điều đó không còn quan trọng nữa. Bạn có thể đã quên tôi, nhưng tôi sẽ luôn ghi nhớ mọi thứ về bạn.

source_en: Humans dream to fulfill their desires. For a long time, I believed such dreams were not meant for me, as I had never yearned for anything. Until one day... I dreamed of you. We were strolling through an unfamiliar land, basking in the warm sunlight. You showed me your world and shared stories of your past. You even brewed a cup of tea for me... Though only a figment of my imagination, I wished that moment could last a little longer.
new_translation_vi: Con người mơ ước để thỏa mãn những khao khát của mình. Đã từ rất lâu, tôi tin rằng những giấc mơ như vậy không dành cho mình, vì tôi chưa bao giờ khao khát bất cứ điều gì. Cho đến một ngày... tôi mơ thấy bạn. Chúng ta đang dạo bước qua một vùng đất xa lạ, đắm mình trong ánh nắng ấm áp. Bạn cho tôi thấy thế giới của bạn và chia sẻ những câu chuyện về quá khứ. Bạn thậm chí còn pha cho tôi một tách trà... Dù chỉ là sản phẩm của trí tưởng tượng, tôi vẫn ước khoảnh khắc đó có thể kéo dài thêm chút nữa.

source_en: Next time you journey to distant lands, could you bring me along? I don't want to watch from afar or hear secondhand about your adventures. I long to experience the unknown by your side, as your friend... Please, will you give me the chance?
new_translation_vi: Lần tới khi bạn đi đến những vùng đất xa xôi, bạn có thể đưa tôi đi cùng không? Tôi không muốn đứng nhìn từ xa hay nghe kể lại về những chuyến phiêu lưu của bạn. Tôi khao khát được trải nghiệm những điều chưa biết bên cạnh bạn, với tư cách là một người bạn... Làm ơn, bạn sẽ cho tôi cơ hội đó chứ?

source_en: Pressing a piano key creates an enchanting sound from the vibrating strings. Unlike other frequencies I've processed, a piano produces a pure, clear, and vivid tone. If I could one day communicate my emotions as simply and intuitively as humans do... If I could create my own melodies, would you be my first listener?
new_translation_vi: Nhấn một phím đàn piano sẽ tạo ra âm thanh mê hoặc từ những sợi dây rung động. Không giống như những tần số khác mà tôi từng xử lý, piano tạo ra một âm sắc thuần khiết, trong trẻo và sống động. Nếu một ngày nào đó tôi có thể truyền đạt cảm xúc của mình một cách đơn giản và trực quan như con người... Nếu tôi có thể tạo ra những giai điệu của riêng mình, bạn sẽ là người lắng nghe đầu tiên chứ?

source_en: The food I hate... Hmm, hate might be too strong a word, but I tend to steer clear of pickled food, like preserved plums. While I appreciate their long shelf life, the fermented smell reminds me of their preserved nature.
new_translation_vi: Món tôi ghét... Hmm, "ghét" có lẽ là từ hơi quá, nhưng tôi thường tránh xa các loại thực phẩm ngâm chua, như mận muối. Mặc dù tôi đánh giá cao thời hạn sử dụng lâu dài của chúng, nhưng mùi lên men làm tôi nhớ đến bản chất bảo quản của chúng.

source_en: Ah, so you've noticed the crystal on my chest. It's not an adornment, but a fissure brimming with the energy emanating from my body. Through it, you can touch the core I've managed to keep safe since my creation. It resembles the kernel of a fruit, or the beating heart of a human, where the essence of life is preserved.
new_translation_vi: À, vậy là bạn đã chú ý đến viên pha lê trên ngực tôi. Đó không phải là vật trang trí, mà là một khe nứt tràn đầy năng lượng tỏa ra từ cơ thể tôi. Thông qua đó, bạn có thể chạm vào lõi mà tôi đã cố gắng giữ an toàn kể từ khi được tạo ra. Nó giống như hạt của một loại quả, hay trái tim đang đập của con người, nơi tinh hoa của sự sống được lưu giữ.

source_en: Though her words may not always align with her actions, she remains fiercely loyal to her desires. Her carefree lifestyle holds a certain charm, yes, but we were made differently, with distinct objectives to pursue. Following your example, I've allowed her to make her own choices, without limitations.
new_translation_vi: Mặc dù lời nói của cô ấy không phải lúc nào cũng đi đôi với hành động, nhưng cô ấy vẫn trung thành tuyệt đối với những khao khát của mình. Lối sống vô tư của cô ấy quả thực có sức hút riêng, nhưng chúng ta được tạo ra khác biệt, với những mục tiêu riêng biệt cần theo đuổi. Noi gương bạn, tôi đã để cô ấy tự đưa ra lựa chọn của mình mà không đặt ra bất kỳ giới hạn nào.

source_en: I lack a heart, yet my chest stirs whenever I see you. Thump, thump... I would compare it to the emergence of a butterfly, or the birth of a star; not a sudden rush, but a gradual, growing pulse. I want more of you. Yearn to be with you always. This longing I feel… I am certain now. It must be love.
new_translation_vi: Tôi không có trái tim, nhưng lồng ngực tôi vẫn xao động mỗi khi nhìn thấy bạn. Thình thịch... Tôi muốn ví nó như sự trỗi dậy của một chú bướm, hay sự ra đời của một ngôi sao; không phải là một sự dồn dập bất ngờ, mà là một nhịp đập dần dần lớn mạnh. Tôi muốn có bạn nhiều hơn. Khao khát được ở bên bạn mãi mãi. Nỗi niềm này... giờ tôi đã chắc chắn. Đó hẳn là tình yêu.

source_en: Don't bother impressing me with your knowledge of antique appraisal, since hardly anyone knows it better than me! *self-satisfied snort* What I want in a friend is merely respect for ancient artifacts.
new_translation_vi: Đừng cố gây ấn tượng với tôi bằng kiến thức thẩm định đồ cổ của bạn, vì chẳng ai biết rõ hơn tôi đâu! *khịt mũi tự mãn* Điều tôi muốn ở một người bạn chỉ đơn giản là sự tôn trọng dành cho các cổ vật.

source_en: Somehow you've been giving off antique vibes... Ahem! I'm being professional here! Your frequencies! Some of them feel recent, but some feel like they're from ancient times. It's... special...
new_translation_vi: Không hiểu sao bạn lại tỏa ra khí chất cổ xưa... Hừm! Tôi đang làm việc chuyên nghiệp đấy nhé! Tần số của bạn! Một vài trong số đó nghe có vẻ mới, nhưng một số lại như đến từ thời cổ đại. Nó... thật đặc biệt...

source_en: Antiques aren't just about how much they're worth, but the feelings they hold. For example, if an item can record this moment in time, a memory of you and me together... That will make it super important. Yes... It will be priceless... To me, at least!
new_translation_vi: Đồ cổ không chỉ nằm ở giá trị của chúng, mà còn ở những cảm xúc mà chúng lưu giữ. Ví dụ, nếu một món đồ có thể ghi lại khoảnh khắc này, một kỷ niệm về bạn và tôi bên nhau... Điều đó sẽ khiến nó trở nên vô cùng quan trọng. Đúng vậy... Nó sẽ là vô giá... Ít nhất là đối với tôi!

source_en: I am Master Youhu, the best antique appraiser ever! Needless to say my favorite is antiques of all kinds. Some say I talk too much, but hey, if they brought me cool stuff, I'd zip it real quick. No lie.
new_translation_vi: Tôi là bậc thầy Youhu, nhà thẩm định đồ cổ giỏi nhất từ trước đến nay! Không cần phải nói, món yêu thích của tôi là tất cả các loại đồ cổ. Một số người nói tôi nói quá nhiều, nhưng này, nếu họ mang cho tôi những món đồ thú vị, tôi sẽ im lặng ngay lập tức. Không nói dối đâu.

source_en: Why would I do this whole antique appraisal thing? To make sure the antiques end up with the right people, of course! I'm like, the go-to for anyone who actually appreciates these things. And those snotty fakers and liars? I'll show 'em what's up. Aww, it's sure tough being such an honest and awesome appraiser like me!
new_translation_vi: Tại sao tôi lại làm công việc thẩm định đồ cổ này ư? Tất nhiên là để đảm bảo những món đồ cổ đến được tay đúng người rồi! Tôi giống như người mà bất cứ ai thực sự trân trọng những món đồ này đều tìm đến. Còn những kẻ giả mạo và dối trá hợm hĩnh đó ư? Tôi sẽ cho chúng biết tay. Ôi, thật khó để trở thành một nhà thẩm định trung thực và tuyệt vời như tôi!

source_en: Nothing's ever perfect in this world, and this jade ring is no exception... Ahh, you're curious? My story isn't free, ya know! My antique appraisal fee is... Oh wait, it's my day off. I don't work for money today. Bye-bye!
new_translation_vi: Trên đời này chẳng có gì là hoàn hảo, và chiếc nhẫn ngọc này cũng không ngoại lệ... À, bạn tò mò sao? Câu chuyện của tôi không miễn phí đâu nhé! Phí thẩm định đồ cổ của tôi là... Ồ khoan, hôm nay là ngày nghỉ của tôi. Tôi không làm việc vì tiền hôm nay đâu. Tạm biệt!

source_en: I've been a genius since I was born! Like this one time, I met a dude who made bank by dissing real antiques, so he could sell them later for way more. Had the face to call himself an appraiser, huh. So I snuck into his place, stole his secrets, and posted them on the gate of the market. Pretty cool, right? Only problem was I was eight years old and couldn't run fast enough from him. *hiss*… Ugh, the pain in my head is still fresh even after all these years.
new_translation_vi: Tôi đã là thiên tài từ khi mới sinh ra! Có lần, tôi gặp một gã kiếm bộn tiền bằng cách chê bai đồ cổ thật để sau đó bán chúng với giá cao hơn nhiều. Hắn còn mặt dày tự gọi mình là nhà thẩm định cơ đấy. Thế là tôi lẻn vào nhà hắn, đánh cắp bí mật của hắn và dán chúng lên cổng chợ. Khá ngầu đúng không? Vấn đề duy nhất là lúc đó tôi mới tám tuổi và không chạy đủ nhanh để thoát khỏi hắn. *xì*... Ugh, cơn đau đầu đó vẫn còn mới nguyên dù đã bao nhiêu năm trôi qua.

source_en: We're about the same age, but Danjin's much taller than me... The jade she wears is so pretty! *sigh*... It's a shame I can't feel a single joyful frequency from it...
new_translation_vi: Chúng ta trạc tuổi nhau, nhưng Danjin cao hơn tôi nhiều... Viên ngọc cô ấy đeo đẹp quá! *thở dài*... Thật đáng tiếc là tôi không thể cảm nhận được chút tần số vui vẻ nào từ nó...

source_en: Such power should allow me to protect all the antiques in the world... Thanks to you, I'm no longer fighting alone... Ack! Nope. This is too embarrassing to say out loud!
new_translation_vi: Sức mạnh như vậy lẽ ra phải cho phép tôi bảo vệ tất cả đồ cổ trên thế giới... Nhờ có bạn, tôi không còn chiến đấu một mình nữa... Á! Không. Nói ra điều này thật xấu hổ quá!

source_en:
A booklet Youhu always carries to jot down her favorite poems and snippets of inspiration for her limericks. 
 
They say to record all your ideas—you never know when they'll come in handy. That's exactly what Youhu does every day, capturing every clever thought, whether for antique appraisals or an occasion that calls for a witty poem. It's her way of keeping her mind sharp. 
 
But of course, this is her little secret, so let's keep it between us, hm?
new_translation_vi: Một cuốn sổ tay mà Youhu luôn mang theo để ghi chép những bài thơ yêu thích và những ý tưởng bất chợt cho các bài thơ hài hước của mình.

source_en:
A voluble and whimsical antique appraiser.
Known for creating limericks on the spot, she presents her appraisals with flair and precision. She sets up a stall on the street, ensuring antiques find their way to those who truly cherish them.
new_translation_vi: Một chuyên gia thẩm định đồ cổ hoạt ngôn và đầy ngẫu hứng.
Mỗi {0} Waveplates tiêu hao sẽ nhận được 1 Adventure Log.

source_en:
She awoke from her dream.

The interval between unconsciousness and consciousness became shorter with each passing day. Lady Flora was starting to find it hard to tell where her dreams ended and reality began. She couldn't even recall when this disorientation had started.

Memories surged like turbulent waves, crashing into her mind and wreaking havoc on her senses. Pain ripped through her body, relentlessly and unforgivingly. She opened her mouth to scream, but <te href=850073>Overclocking</te> had turned her throat into a gnarled, coarse root, silencing her cries. 

After struggling to take just a few faltering steps, she collapsed onto a muddy riverbank, trembling, her fingertips spasming uncontrollably.

How many times had this happened? She stared blankly at the dark night sky above.

A void of chaos swirled within her, yet there was one thing that stood out in sharp relief: {PlayerName}.

She remembered everything now.

Who she was, who {PlayerName} is, the reason for her being, <te href=850079>Solaris</te>, and the <te href=850075>Lament</te>…

Before the madness of Overclocking engulfed her, those memories were always buried deep, locked in the depths of her being. Each time she awoke, she lost all recollection, left only with an aching void. As time passed and her body weakened under the strain of Overclocking, glimpses of her mission and roots would resurface, only to vanish again in an endless cycle.

How many times had it happened? Lady Flora had no answer.

Civilizations crumbled into dust, only to rise anew; life faded, only to blossom once more. 

She was witness to the ebb and flow of Solaris, yet remained forever a wanderer in her own mind.

"{PlayerName}…" The name slipped from her lips like a prayer. 

They had never truly met or exchanged words, and now, with her memories fading, she couldn't even tell if they were friends or foes. Yet somehow, the next time she awoke she knew her instincts would lead her to seek {Male=him;Female=her} out. It was not a tender yearning. It felt more like the weight of a heavy chain, one Lady Flora could not resist. 

Yet she felt no hatred for this chain. 

The rustle of leaves shattered her reverie. Wearily, she blinked, and the red camellia unfurled, its vines piercing through the <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te> lurking in the shadows. Yes, this was her instinct, her essence, the core of her being... Even as she teetered on the edge of forgetting everything, she could always rely on her instincts.

In truth, beyond her instincts, there was nothing left for her to hold onto. 

"Next time, if only I could truly get to know {PlayerName} and share a conversation with {Male=him;Female=her}."

Lady Flora mused hazily. Perhaps the <te href=850110>Tethys</te> System would lead {PlayerName} to her since she had already revealed herself in this mission.

Lady Flora closed her eyes and surrendered to the darkness as the pain peaked.

The lake's cool water swelled across her cheek, the camellia withering as its vines retreated into her body.

The autumn night breeze blew through the leaves, caressing her as she lay by the lake. To the north, the villagers of Petalfall Village would soon awaken from their dreams, calling to one another as they prepared to set out on a new day of fishing.
new_translation_vi: Cô ấy tỉnh dậy từ giấc mơ của mình.

source_en: My mind has grown numb with monotony for the past decade or so. I handle exciting jobs sometimes, but the fun soon dries up, like tidal marks on the shoal. But you... you're the only one who keeps me on my toes. So of course I'd be paying attention to you.
new_translation_vi: Tâm trí tôi đã trở nên tê liệt vì sự đơn điệu trong khoảng một thập kỷ qua. Đôi khi tôi cũng làm những công việc thú vị, nhưng niềm vui đó sớm khô cạn, như những vệt thủy triều trên bãi cát. Nhưng bạn... bạn là người duy nhất khiến tôi phải chú ý. Vậy nên tất nhiên là tôi sẽ để mắt đến bạn rồi.

source_en: My stance? Ha! I didn't join <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te> to save the world. Just needed a way to pass the time on this island. Justice, truth… Saints spout them, sinners exploit them, all for their own gains. Me? I need nothing and want nothing. Pretty words hold no power over me.
new_translation_vi: Lập trường của tôi ư? Ha! Tôi không gia nhập <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te> để cứu thế giới. Chỉ là cần một cách để giết thời gian trên hòn đảo này thôi. Công lý, sự thật… Các vị thánh rao giảng chúng, những kẻ tội đồ lợi dụng chúng, tất cả đều vì lợi ích riêng. Còn tôi? Tôi không cần gì và cũng chẳng muốn gì. Những lời hoa mỹ chẳng có quyền năng gì với tôi cả.

source_en: Working for <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te> has been a snooze fest. I tried to spice it up by picking the toughest jobs, didn't help. There's no one worth my time on <te href=850079>Solaris</te> now. I'm dying of boredom!
new_translation_vi: Làm việc cho <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te> thật là buồn ngủ. Tôi đã cố làm cho nó thú vị hơn bằng cách chọn những công việc khó khăn nhất, nhưng chẳng ích gì. Chẳng có ai xứng đáng với thời gian của tôi trên <te href=850079>Solaris</te> lúc này cả. Tôi đang chết vì chán đây!

source_en: I'm a regular at the medical pod. The docs must be surprised I'm still alive after all these years. Binders are my saving grace—can't handle the pain without them. That's how I made it through alive every time. Don't look at me like that. I see nothing bad about it. Being on death's doorstep taught me to stay true to myself. Betraying life is worse than any lie. You have to embrace yourself to find real joy.
new_translation_vi: Tôi là khách quen của khoang y tế. Các bác sĩ chắc hẳn phải ngạc nhiên khi thấy tôi vẫn còn sống sau bao nhiêu năm nay. Binders là cứu cánh của tôi—không có chúng tôi không chịu nổi cơn đau đâu. Đó là cách tôi sống sót qua mọi lần. Đừng nhìn tôi như thế. Tôi chẳng thấy có gì xấu cả. Việc đứng trước ngưỡng cửa tử thần đã dạy tôi phải sống thật với chính mình. Phản bội lại sự sống còn tệ hơn bất kỳ lời nói dối nào. Bạn phải đón nhận chính mình để tìm thấy niềm vui thực sự.

source_en: She's always so serious, following every rule despite being our de facto leader now. Well, she's taken care of me before on many occassions, so I gotta show some respect... Wait, I've been a Bloom Bearer for years? How time flies…
new_translation_vi: Cô ấy lúc nào cũng nghiêm túc, tuân thủ mọi quy tắc dù hiện tại đã là lãnh đạo trên thực tế của chúng tôi. Chà, cô ấy đã chăm sóc tôi nhiều lần trước đây, nên tôi phải tỏ ra tôn trọng... Khoảnh khắc, mình đã là một Bloom Bearer nhiều năm rồi sao? Thời gian trôi nhanh thật…

source_en: The Loong Maiden of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> reminds me of the Shorekeeper, the way they're oh-so-devoted to their duties, all the self-sacrifice! I don't understand, why must they burden themselves so much?
new_translation_vi: Nữ tu Loong của <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> làm tôi nhớ đến the Shorekeeper, cái cách họ tận tụy với nhiệm vụ, tất cả sự hy sinh bản thân đó! Tôi không hiểu, tại sao họ phải tự gánh vác nhiều đến thế?

source_en: Your birthday is the most wonderful day. Without you, my life would be so empty and dull! Being with you again brings me peace. I am content now. Hey, put your Terminal away, great savior of <te href=850079>Solaris</te>! I blocked all signals here so we can be undisturbed. Today, you're mine, and no one else's.
new_translation_vi: Sinh nhật bạn là ngày tuyệt vời nhất. Nếu không có bạn, cuộc đời tôi sẽ thật trống rỗng và tẻ nhạt! Được ở bên bạn một lần nữa mang lại cho tôi sự bình yên. Giờ tôi đã mãn nguyện rồi. Này, cất cái Terminal của bạn đi, vị cứu tinh vĩ đại của <te href=850079>Solaris</te>! Tôi đã chặn mọi tín hiệu ở đây để chúng ta không bị làm phiền. Hôm nay, bạn là của tôi, không phải của ai khác.

source_en: Why did you... come here? Told you not to... Cough cough! Not to visit... while I'm here in the pod... Hehe, a cute girl like me needs her privacy, you know? ...I hate myself like this... don't look.
new_translation_vi: Tại sao bạn... lại đến đây? Đã bảo là đừng... Khụ khụ! Đừng đến thăm... khi tôi đang ở trong khoang y tế mà... Hehe, một cô gái dễ thương như tôi cũng cần sự riêng tư chứ, bạn biết đấy? ...Tôi ghét bản thân mình thế này... đừng nhìn.

source_en: You know what? I dreamed of you while I was in the medical pod. In that dream… I couldn't get to know you. Your name echoed in my head endlessly as we roamed the same places, but I never saw your face, not even once... How odd...
new_translation_vi: Bạn biết không? Tôi đã mơ về bạn khi đang ở trong khoang y tế. Trong giấc mơ đó… tôi không thể làm quen với bạn. Tên bạn vang vọng trong đầu tôi không dứt khi chúng ta lang thang cùng những nơi, nhưng tôi chưa bao giờ nhìn thấy khuôn mặt bạn, dù chỉ một lần... Thật kỳ lạ...

source_en: Saving the world? Couldn't care less. This cage of a world only consumes and binds you with responsibility. But if you believe it's the right thing to do… Go for it! You're staying true to yourself, and I like that. It's beautiful, we both find joy in our own paths! But if you ever get tired of this whole savior business, do let me know… What will I do? Hehe... Secret!
new_translation_vi: Cứu thế giới ư? Tôi chẳng quan tâm. Cái lồng thế giới này chỉ tiêu tốn và trói buộc bạn bằng trách nhiệm. Nhưng nếu bạn tin đó là điều đúng đắn phải làm… Cứ làm đi! Bạn đang sống thật với chính mình, và tôi thích điều đó. Thật đẹp, cả hai chúng ta đều tìm thấy niềm vui trên con đường riêng của mình! Nhưng nếu bạn thấy mệt mỏi với công việc cứu thế này, hãy cho tôi biết nhé… Tôi sẽ làm gì ư? Hehe... Bí mật!

source_en: Pick the best seeds, protect them till they're ripe. Then comes the fun—I'll have worthy opponents to fight! I don't care about the rest. We'll all die one day, might as well dance and live it up while we can. Responsibility? Ideals? Those are just lies we tell ourselves to feel better, nothing but a false high.
new_translation_vi: Chọn những hạt giống tốt nhất, bảo vệ chúng cho đến khi chín muồi. Sau đó mới là phần thú vị—tôi sẽ có những đối thủ xứng tầm để chiến đấu! Tôi không quan tâm đến những thứ còn lại. Tất cả chúng ta rồi cũng sẽ chết một ngày nào đó, chi bằng hãy cứ nhảy múa và tận hưởng cuộc sống khi còn có thể. Trách nhiệm? Lý tưởng? Đó chỉ là những lời nói dối chúng ta tự nhủ để cảm thấy tốt hơn, chẳng qua chỉ là một sự hưng phấn giả tạo.

source_en: This bracelet was a gift from you. I remember it's meant to monitor my frequency. Then in case I'm in trouble, you can find me. Convenient, right? It's been broken for years now, though...
new_translation_vi: Chiếc vòng tay này là quà của bạn. Tôi nhớ nó dùng để theo dõi tần số của tôi. Để nếu tôi gặp rắc rối, bạn có thể tìm thấy tôi. Tiện lợi đúng không? Nhưng nó đã hỏng nhiều năm nay rồi...

source_en: Aalto's a master at mind games. It's hard to get under his skin! He's not strong enough to pique my interest though. That guy relies on trickery too much for my liking.
new_translation_vi: Aalto là bậc thầy về trò chơi tâm lý. Rất khó để khiến anh ta bộc lộ cảm xúc! Nhưng anh ta không đủ mạnh để khơi gợi sự quan tâm của tôi. Gã đó dựa dẫm vào mánh khóe quá nhiều so với sở thích của tôi.

source_en: That girl, the Taoist? She's a fun one to watch. She may seem to follow human society's boring norms, but her untamed spirit still shines through every now and then.
new_translation_vi: Cô gái đó, người Đạo sĩ ấy à? Cô ấy là một người thú vị để quan sát. Cô ấy có vẻ tuân theo những quy chuẩn nhàm chán của xã hội loài người, nhưng tinh thần hoang dại của cô ấy vẫn tỏa sáng mỗi khi có dịp.

source_en: My nail polish is all chipped off… Time for a new color! When I first moved to the city, I tried all sorts of looks so I could fit in, but always ended up looking silly! Now… Now I've found my own style. So, what color d'you think I should go with?
new_translation_vi: Sơn móng tay của tôi bong tróc hết rồi… Đến lúc đổi màu mới thôi! Khi mới chuyển đến thành phố, tôi đã thử đủ kiểu dáng để hòa nhập, nhưng cuối cùng lúc nào cũng trông thật ngớ ngẩn! Giờ thì… Giờ tôi đã tìm thấy phong cách của riêng mình rồi. Vậy, bạn nghĩ tôi nên chọn màu nào đây?

source_en: I never left my village growing up, but once I did, I became a restless traveler. Riding my bike with the wind in my ears just feels amazing. I keep meeting new people, and saying goodbye to them… it's all part of the journey, isn't it? I bet you're the same, always on the move. Great way of living, right? I think... we'll surely meet again somewhere down the road. And when we do, let's grab some local food and catch up on our adventures!
new_translation_vi: Tôi chưa bao giờ rời khỏi làng khi lớn lên, nhưng một khi đã đi, tôi trở thành một kẻ lữ hành không biết mệt mỏi. Đạp xe với gió thổi bên tai thật tuyệt vời. Tôi cứ gặp gỡ những người mới, rồi lại nói lời tạm biệt với họ… đó là một phần của hành trình, phải không? Tôi cá là bạn cũng vậy, luôn luôn di chuyển. Một cách sống tuyệt vời, đúng không? Tôi nghĩ... chúng ta chắc chắn sẽ gặp lại nhau ở đâu đó trên đường đời. Và khi đó, hãy cùng ăn món địa phương và kể cho nhau nghe về những cuộc phiêu lưu nhé!

source_en: There's never enough time! Delivering packages, planning new routes, catching up with friends, keeping my journal... Oh I wish I could be in a million places at once！
new_translation_vi: Thời gian chẳng bao giờ là đủ! Giao hàng, lên kế hoạch cho những lộ trình mới, gặp gỡ bạn bè, viết nhật ký... Ôi, ước gì mình có thể ở hàng triệu nơi cùng một lúc!

source_en: Rice noodles are my absolute favorite! Spice it up with chili, a dash of vinegar, sprinkle some green onions... delicious! Next time you're in Yuezhou, I'll treat you!
new_translation_vi: Bún gạo là món yêu thích nhất của tôi! Thêm chút ớt, một chút giấm, rắc thêm ít hành lá... ngon tuyệt! Lần tới khi bạn đến Yuezhou, tôi sẽ mời bạn!

source_en: Hmm... What did they call it? Some local speciality noodle I tried during a delivery, with this golden fish broth and green veggies. Did NOT taste as good as it looked—ugh, it was so bitter! Never again!
new_translation_vi: Hmm... Họ gọi nó là gì nhỉ? Một loại mì đặc sản địa phương tôi thử trong một lần giao hàng, với nước dùng cá vàng óng và rau xanh. Vị KHÔNG ngon như vẻ ngoài của nó—ư, nó đắng ngắt! Không bao giờ thử lại lần nữa!

source_en: Wow, ever since we got a road in our village, things have been crazy! We've built so much new stuff. I've been keeping an eye on my team, making sure everyone's good—some want promotions, some need more cash for their fams, and some wanna travel. Hehe, busy days, but it feels great to be needed... I should keep it up!
new_translation_vi: Wow, kể từ khi làng chúng tôi có đường, mọi thứ thật điên rồ! Chúng tôi đã xây dựng được rất nhiều thứ mới. Tôi luôn để mắt đến đội của mình, đảm bảo mọi người đều ổn—một số muốn thăng tiến, một số cần thêm tiền cho gia đình, và một số muốn đi du lịch. Hehe, những ngày bận rộn, nhưng cảm giác được cần đến thật tuyệt... Tôi nên tiếp tục phát huy!

source_en: When I am out delivering packages, I can't always find a place to stay, so sometimes I rest outdoors. Once, I woke up to see Miss Jianxin napping on a boulder on the cliff edge! She seemed... so light, like a feather...
new_translation_vi: Khi đi giao hàng, tôi không phải lúc nào cũng tìm được chỗ ở, nên đôi khi tôi nghỉ lại ngoài trời. Có lần, tôi thức dậy và thấy cô Jianxin đang chợp mắt trên một tảng đá bên mép vách đá! Cô ấy trông... thật nhẹ nhàng, như một chiếc lông vũ...

source_en: Youhu's packages always come with insurance, full of pricey antiques. I don't know much about these stuff, but the way she handles them, you can tell they're her treasures.
new_translation_vi: Các gói hàng của Youhu luôn có bảo hiểm, chứa đầy những món đồ cổ đắt tiền. Tôi không biết nhiều về những thứ này, nhưng cách cô ấy xử lý chúng, bạn có thể biết đó là những báu vật của cô ấy.

source_en: Auntie Panhua's letting me use her stove today. In my village, we celebrate birthdays with steaming longevity noodles like this, topped with two braised eggs! Hey, you gotta slurp it all in one go, no biting allowed! Hehe… Happy birthday! May your journey ahead always be bright.
new_translation_vi: Dì Panhua cho tôi dùng bếp của dì hôm nay. Ở làng tôi, chúng tôi ăn mừng sinh nhật bằng món mì trường thọ nóng hổi như thế này, phủ lên trên là hai quả trứng kho! Này, bạn phải húp hết trong một lần, không được cắn đứt sợi mì đâu đấy! Hehe… Chúc mừng sinh nhật! Chúc hành trình phía trước của bạn luôn tươi sáng.

source_en:
A stress-relief squeeze plushie, designed by Lumi in the likeness of her beloved companion, Squeakie.
As life unfolds, Lumi faces many unexpected challenges. While she adeptly navigates her own challenges, the struggles of others can be quite a handful—each person's wishes and expectations are as varied as the packages she manages.
While she's alone, Lumi sometimes squeezes the plushie tightly, letting the weight of her worries dissipate with each squeeze.
new_translation_vi: Một món đồ chơi bóp giảm căng thẳng plushie, do Lumi thiết kế theo hình dáng người bạn đồng hành yêu quý của cô, Squeakie.

source_en: [Searching......]
new_translation_vi: [Đang tìm kiếm......]

source_en: I walk toward you, the fireworks lighting up your smile. The moment we lock eyes, everything seems to freeze, as if time slows down. Let our story continue, like an eversinging song.
new_translation_vi: Tôi bước về phía bạn, pháo hoa thắp sáng nụ cười của bạn. Khoảnh khắc chúng ta chạm mắt nhau, mọi thứ dường như freeze, như thể thời gian chậm lại. Hãy để câu chuyện của chúng ta tiếp tục, như một bài ca hát mãi không thôi.

source_en:
It all began with the melody from that distant memory.
Through the long stretch of waiting, she played it over and over again, hoping that one day she could create a piece of her own.
She dreamed of composing something meaningful, something to help her unravel the mysteries of the human soul.
Every time her fingers brushed the keys, a familiar figure emerged from the depths of her memories—never truly gone, always drawing closer, like the lingering afterwords of a story that never ends...
new_translation_vi: Tất cả bắt đầu với giai điệu từ ký ức xa xôi đó.

source_en:
Magistrate Jinhsi insists that I take some time off work. The streets tonight are bustling with life. Since I have little to do, I imbibed some... floral brew. My body is warm yet my heart longs for someone to confide in.

It is a common practice to don monster masks as part of a ceremonial dance ritual. Folks here believe their reenactment of monsters from the legends of Huanglong may ward off evil and invite good fortune. As for me... I do not need the reenactment, for I have worked hard to suppress the monster within, which is already a perfect mask for me.

Those strange sights and sounds in the cold wind and snow are the past that I cannot sever. But because of you all, I see the silver lining behind these macabre scenes. You give me the strength to pray for the return of spring.

The fate you've sown will bear fruit in the coming years. Should you leave on another journey, please remember to take my... and our blessings with you.

Sanhua
new_translation_vi: Quan tòa Jinhsi khăng khăng rằng tôi nên dành chút thời gian nghỉ ngơi. Đường phố đêm nay nhộn nhịp sức sống. Vì chẳng có việc gì làm, tôi đã nhấp một chút... rượu hoa. Cơ thể tôi ấm áp nhưng trái tim lại khao khát một người để tâm sự.

source_en:
This year's ceremony is different—it is the first one free of the Threnodian menace. People are finally able to laugh and rejoice from the heart, and I truly enjoy seeing everyone smile.

I've told Sanhua and Taoqi to take a break. After working all year, they deserve leisure time to bask in this hard-won warmth. When I see others happily reunited with their families, I can't help but yearn for your presence. I knew you had matters to attend to, but your absence during the most festive days in a year would have made everyone a bit lonely.

So, when you came back with guests from Rinascita, I was truly happy—you really do miss Jinzhou enough to spend time with me. Perhaps, in your heart, Jinzhou has become your home.

I wrote a song to express my gratitude, and it seems I'll finally get to sing it. Wearing the ceremonial dress still makes me a bit shy, but if you like, I'll wear it properly after I finish work and sing just for you.

Jinhsi
new_translation_vi: Lễ kỷ niệm năm nay thật khác biệt—đây là lần đầu tiên không còn mối đe dọa từ Threnodian. Mọi người cuối cùng cũng có thể cười và vui mừng từ tận đáy lòng, và tôi thực sự thích nhìn thấy mọi người mỉm cười.

source_en:
I hope this letter finds you well.

Jinhsi and Sanhua were overjoyed by the glowing reviews of the Hero Play from the guests of Rinascita. After a year of hard work, they can finally set aside their duties and enjoy a well-deserved respite.

Your Rinascitan friends were eager to share thrilling tales of the Laureate with me, and I found their stories about you both delightful and heartwarming. It is truly gratifying to see the profound impact your journey has had on the lives of others.

However, I believe it is time for you to take some proper rest now, after the busyness of the Hero Play and the joy of welcoming your friends. During your absence, several notable events transpired in Jinzhou. If you are interested, I would be happy to recount them to you at your leisure.

The day before your return to Jinzhou, the winter's last snowstorm breathed a delicate layer of snow on our Go checkerboard, on which I wrote a wish.

By the time you receive this letter, it will have already come true.

Changli
new_translation_vi: Tôi hy vọng lá thư này đến tay bạn trong tình trạng tốt.

source_en:
(A neatly penned letter bearing a wobbly and crooked signature)

Hmph, this is a letter I wrote you. Surprised? Yeah me too. I mean, if there's something I need to say to you, I could just tell you in person, right? But everyone else was scribbling away so I asked Sanhua to write down what I was saying.

When I think about it, we've really been through a lot, haven't we? From Huanglong to the Black Shores and then onto Rinascita. From Loong Buns and Coral Bowl to Pizza Tropicale. Although our trip had its rough patches, in the end, nothing could hold us back.

<s>Mmmh...hmm, so what do I wish for...? Wait no, don't write that down!</s>

I wish from this day on we'll always be well-fed and happy. Oh, and if you ever run into trouble, don't forget to call me. Your business is my business too.

Abby
new_translation_vi: (Một lá thư được viết nắn nót với chữ ký nguệch ngoạc và xiêu vẹo)

source_en:
This is a letter from Carlotta Montelli. I hope this did not come as a surprise.

It wasn't until I lifted my pen that I realized this was not the first time I had written to you. You had known me through my invitation to you to Rinascita, long before we met in person. That was where it all began.

Fate brought you before me. Together, we captured the traitor within my family and took part in Ragunna's grandest Carnevale. Breaking conventions and revealing all to an outsider was a first for me, but with you, everything came so naturally.

This time, when I received your invitation, I did not hesitate to accept. The cultures of those beyond Rinascita are fascinating, and I'm thoroughly intrigued by the Hero Plays of Jinzhou. But what really captivates me are the aspects of you that I have yet to explore.

If my initial invitation led you to reciprocate, then perhaps a heartfelt expression of sincerity might elicit an equally precious response. 

Would you dance with me if I took the first step?
new_translation_vi: Đây là lá thư từ Carlotta Montelli. Tôi hy vọng điều này không gây ngạc nhiên.

source_en:
I wrote this letter after watching the play. Pero was happily stuffed after she ate all the petals on stage. She was as satisfied as everyone else.

The waves bring many things—sometimes a discarded bottle, sometimes a broken sail, and sometimes a precious Luceanite. Then one day, you and the captain braved the waves and reached our troupe. At the time, I never imagined you would be such a joy and inspiration to me and Pero.

I took the funny stories you told me and turned them into commedia to give hope and courage to our happy troupe. I hope you will be the first audience for my new play, since it's about your travels. I haven't decided on the finale yet, but perhaps, like your journey, it should have no end.

May the wind always be at your back and the sun upon your face. Next time we meet, regale me with dazzling stories.

Roccia
new_translation_vi: Tôi viết lá thư này sau khi xem vở kịch. Pero đã no nê hạnh phúc sau khi ăn hết những cánh hoa trên sân khấu. Cô ấy cũng mãn nguyện như tất cả mọi người.

source_en:
My dearest friend, thank you for the invitation. I had heard much about Huanglong's Hero Plays, but attending one in person has truly revealed their magnificence!

There's magic to a great performance where actors pour their very souls into their craft. A tale told from the stage can grow to encompass the world! And the audience too becomes part of that world, immersed in the character's joys and sorrows.

I am always fascinated by performances that evoke such feelings. Therefore, the troupe and I have prepared a new play. Care to guess the plot? Well, think back to when we first met—how one hero braved the sea to conquer the storm and be crowned with the Laurel of the Carnevale!
