If the world is like an ocean, then the frequencies of humans and the world influence and shape one another. The wondrous water has been imbued with the human spirit, symbolizing the cycle of life and death. If water represents the subconscious, it also serves as a harbor for fantasies and desires.

This is why research into the Remnant domain is also prevalent within the Order.

The Seminary of the Forgotten in Rinascita was once flooded by Nimbus Sanctum, which later proved to be a manifestation of Remnant Energy, recording the emotions and memories of humans without distinction, and then reflecting them in reality.

With the old site of the Seminary still present, Nimbus Sanctum holds a special allure for Acolytes of the Order, who visit to pray or salvage ancient texts.
Some scholars believe the Remnant Cloud is a higher-dimensional form of water, while others speculate that another world exists beneath Nimbus Sanctum.

[Theory IV: Water is All-Encompassing]
This all-encompassing nature is why Ragunna, under the guidance of the Order, is a city that welcomes exiles from all walks of life and grants them equal rights. The Carnevale is the epitome of this inclusiveness. Ragunnesi from various isles unite to honor their hometowns and families lost in the Lament. Dressed in their traditional clothing and wearing masks symbolizing ancestors and totems, they perform a variety of dramas. The diversity and inclusiveness lie at the core of the performances during the Carnevale.

[Theory V: Unity]
Taking inspiration from the all-encompassing nature of water, Primus Fenrico, upon assuming power, developed the doctrine of Unity and enshrined it in the Codex.

For the exiled people of Rinascita, formed after the Lament, religion is not merely a practice in the Order but a collection of science, philosophy, politics, individual identity, and the hope for salvation. The civilization of Rinascita is anchored around faith, meaning religion is not just a personal pursuit but a universal truth that explains the world and defines one's place within it.

Any heretical theory that undermines or challenges this faith is seen as a dagger aimed at the heart of truth itself. Such ideas threaten the existence of those around them and risk tearing apart the fabric of society, bringing calamity and destruction to this city by the sea.

The Primus believes that whenever the ideology of Division reaches its zenith, the calamity of the Dark Tide will descend from above, endangering the very existence of Rinascita. For this reason, even the Carnevale, which embodies the spirit of inclusiveness, must be overseen by the Order.
new_translation_vi: [Lý thuyết III: Nước có tính phản chiếu]

source_en: I once joked to a friend that if, one day, you find yourself wanted across all of Solaris-3 for illegal actions like short selling or trading in debts, then, based on my experience, apart from digging your own grave, your best bet would be to hide in Averardo Vault in Rinascita. As long as you can prove your worth, the Montelli family will keep you safe—even if it means turning a blind eye. They'll go so far as to pay your bail out of their own pockets and assemble a professional international legal team for you, with only one condition: that you build strong business ties with them. Trust me on this, I deal a lot with the Montellis. They value the so-called "spirit of the contract" more than most businessmen. Back when I was younger, I couldn't stand those brash islanders. They didn't play by the rules, were full of energy, and always spoke their minds. They were nothing like the Rinascitan people I knew, who were all about dance and performance. But over time, I came to recognize a trait in them that others lacked. They always price everything upfront. The Montellis are by far the easiest businessmen to understand because their world operates on just one principle: the contract. And the only thing driving that principle? Profit. —Excerpt from How to Get Unlimited Shell Credits
new_translation_vi: Tôi từng đùa với một người bạn rằng nếu một ngày nào đó, bạn thấy mình bị truy nã trên khắp Solaris-3 vì các hành động bất hợp pháp như bán khống hoặc giao dịch nợ, thì dựa trên kinh nghiệm của tôi, ngoài việc tự đào mồ chôn mình, lựa chọn tốt nhất của bạn là trốn trong Hầm Averardo ở Rinascita. Miễn là bạn có thể chứng minh giá trị của mình, gia đình Montelli sẽ giữ bạn an toàn—ngay cả khi điều đó có nghĩa là nhắm mắt làm ngơ. Họ thậm chí sẽ trả tiền bảo lãnh cho bạn từ túi riêng của họ và tập hợp một đội ngũ pháp lý quốc tế chuyên nghiệp cho bạn, với một điều kiện duy nhất: rằng bạn xây dựng mối quan hệ kinh doanh bền chặt với họ. Hãy tin tôi, tôi giao dịch rất nhiều với nhà Montelli. Họ coi trọng cái gọi là "tinh thần hợp đồng" hơn hầu hết các doanh nhân. Hồi còn trẻ, tôi không thể chịu nổi những kẻ dân đảo thô lỗ đó. Họ không chơi theo luật, tràn đầy năng lượng, và luôn nói thẳng suy nghĩ của mình.

source_en: As long as projected earnings outweigh the risks, the Montellis will go to any lengths to fulfill the contract. They never turn down a deal that lands on their doorstep and always deliver once the client has paid. Their team possesses a unique, almost magnetic force, uniting individuals driven by ambition and the promise of fame. But don't expect to hear talk of ethics or loyalty—profit is the only metric that matters. It's hard to wrap your head around, isn't it? A family that has its hands in Echo technology, global trade, banking, private arms, and once even currency manipulation, yet they don't rely on bloodlines to sustain the empire. Decades have passed, and the fortune stashed in Averardo Vault must be beyond imagination. To protect it, they've even imported specialized tech and upgraded their Echoes into formidable war machines. Trust me, gentlemen—no matter how confident you are in your abilities, never, ever even entertain the thought of going after that vault. —Excerpt from How to Get Unlimited Shells

source_en:
In my observation, up until six or seven years ago, most people sent to the Fool's Sails never really believed they'd end up there.

Back then, Acolytes still tried to persuade those who had gone astray, reminding them they had a choice and could still change their ways. If only they knew their fate, they would surely alter it.

I believe that at the time, most Acolytes genuinely preached with compassion, even though they couldn't foresee the consequences.

After all, everything that needs to be foreseen is already laid out in the oracle of the Primus, isn't it?

"Wait not to correct mistakes after they are made. Save the misguided before they act foolishly."

source_en:
Without the revelation of the Enlightened One, this idea is undoubtedly a paradox: humans cannot decide the outcome before the cause—just as it is impossible for a child to be born before the mother. But this, in fact, is the very greatness of the Primus. This is the grace granted by our Sentinel!

I am simply filled with awe:

O how great you are, Fenrico, the Enlightened One! O how great Thou are, Sentinel Imperator!

The Fools who were sent to the ship are the peculiar outliers marked by Ragunna, unable to understand the principle of Unity upheld by the Order. As the line from that famous play says, "One is all, and all is one." To be "one" is the ideal of Ragunna, and those who cannot shape themselves into that singular ideal can never truly belong to the "all."

Notes: Send this heathen to the ship immediately! No delay! Such rebellious, sarcastic talk must be dealt with!

"Hey, what did you do to get banished here?"

"Me? I just repeated they were saying..."

source_en:
These are the lyrics from the final scene of an ancient opera, preserved by the Order. It is said that no one remembers its melody:
 
O sea of clouds!
Cease your workings!
The faint shimmer beneath the water,
It's the trace of my beloved!
Let the endless sea
Take me and my homeland away!
The eternal, unsettling dream!
It descended upon me!
O mighty Imperator!
After a life of sorrow,
Might I finally find the peace I've prayed for?
But no! It's only an empty longing!
Peace never comes through a Divine Envoy!

source_en:
As an employee at the Ragunna branch of the Pioneer Association, I rarely bring up my hometown with colleagues.

I come from a small town called Egla, which fits every definition of a "small town"—simple, a bit behind the times, and quiet, at least during daylight hours. Through my business travels worldwide, I've seen many such towns. Most eventually merge into larger, fortified cities for protection from TDs or the Lament. Few people realize, however, that Egla's history as a settlement is nearly as ancient as Ragunna's, and it had stubbornly kept much of its original character.

Within the Order, there's a well-known piece of advice: never anger the elders of Egla.

Visitors to Egla might encounter a few lively elders who seem like humble figures, be it a local mayor or an innkeeper. But behind these modest roles, many were once people of influence, even retired Acolytes or Priests of the Order who served alongside the Primus, interpreted the oracles, or shaped doctrines. When Ragunna was still a city on the rise, these elders—or their forebears—stood on the front lines, helping lay its very foundations. After long, distinguished careers, they returned to Egla, choosing to spend their later years in the place where it all began.

source_en:
What is it, exactly, that keeps people returning to Egla Town?
 
Honestly, I can't quite understand the mindset of that generation.
 
The last time I left my hometown, I saw a group of elders gathered in front of an abandoned house, almost as if they were holding a vigil.
 
They stood there for a long time in silence before one of them spoke, reflecting on the past:
 
"Old friend, time doesn't turn back. You can't live forever in what might have been. You need to understand that the present isn't necessarily worse than the past. It might even be better... We couldn't save that child in the end. But we should be grateful for the majority we did save."

What is it, exactly, that keeps people returning to Egla Town?
 
Honestly, I can't quite understand the mindset of that generation.
 
The last time I left my hometown, I saw a group of elders gathered in front of an abandoned house, almost as if they were holding a vigil.
 
They stood there for a long time in silence before one of them spoke, reflecting on the past:
 
"Old friend, time doesn't turn back. You can't live forever in what might have been. You need to understand that the present isn't necessarily worse than the past. It might even be better... We couldn't save that child in the end. But we should be grateful for the majority we did save."

This is a transcript of an interview that occurred in the Montelli family.

- Good day. I've been assigned as your consultant for this case. You can refer to me as No. 35.

- No. 35? Don't you have an actual name?

- I beg your understanding, sir. Those of us in this line of work prefer to keep our dealings strictly professional, with no entanglement beyond the task at hand.

- Alright, then. What's your plan regarding this employee's contract?

- Termination.

- And...? No emotional support, no severance, no kind words to soften the blow?

- No. Just termination.

- What? Then why would the Montellis need you for this? I could handle it myself, and probably better.

- Are you sure, sir? Are you prepared to look this young woman in the eye—a girl who's worked tirelessly for this family, despite being separated from her own mother—and tell her, without a hint of empathy, "I'm sorry, but you haven't brought sufficient value to the family. We have to let you go." If you're certain you can do that, then be my guest.

source_en:
- I... I can certainly do that. Besides, there's no need to be so harsh, is there?

- If you're not harsh enough, sir, you may very well be the next to face dismissal. Be too lenient, and you risk failing to generate value for the family and wasting extra compensation. Even if you manage the dismissal, the staff may start seeing you as cold-hearted. The Montellis are a big family, aren't they? Who would do that to their own family?

- So... That's it? I'm supposed to pay a hefty sum to hire you just to let her go? Feels like extortion. But you're right. I can't be the one damaging the family's reputation.

- So, you plan to hire a Resonator or someone with similar resistance at the standard employee wage? Besides, are we certain she actually lost the cargo? My last employer once broke down when he was dismissed, sharing a story about his supervisor...

- You... How dare you bring that up? This conversation is over. Just do it your way.

source_en:
10 Fun Facts You May Have Missed in the Pioneer Association's Historical Documentary: Land of the Sentinel!

1. All scenes depicting miracles and myths were filmed on the Fagaceae Peninsula, the only location abundant with the distinctive Viscum Viride. Interestingly, plant lineage studies suggest that Viscum Viride is most likely not native to Rinascita.
 
2. For scenes featuring Napoli the Second, the Order of the Deep denied the crew access to film within their Cathedral. Instead, the crew used ruins in the Fagaceae Peninsula to complete these shots. The reason for the denial was that the actor portraying Napoli the Second had previously played a merchant who falls in love with an Acolyte in another documentary.

3. The backstory of the Fisalia family's rise to prominence is loosely based on a legendary wealthy merchant from the New Federation, as the Fisalia family declined to share their own history for the documentary.

4. In the documentary, the Blessed Maiden is shown helping villagers pick fruit as a child. However, there are no fruit trees near Egla Town. This scene was actually filmed on the Fagaceae Peninsula.

The reason for the denial was that the actor portraying Napoli the Second had previously played a merchant who falls in love with an Acolyte in another documentary.

3. The backstory of the Fisalia family's rise to prominence is loosely based on a legendary wealthy merchant from the New Federation, as the Fisalia family declined to share their own history for the documentary.

4. In the documentary, the Blessed Maiden is shown helping villagers pick fruit as a child. However, there are no fruit trees near Egla Town. This scene was actually filmed on the Fagaceae Peninsula.

This is a trial record from many years ago, conducted by the Order Tribunal of the Order of the Deep.

Trial location: Side Hall Courtroom of the Tidal Sanctuary, Ragunna.
Trial personnel: Presiding Judge - Cosimo from the 10th Court of the Order Tribunal
Judicial officers - Friedrich of the Order Tribunal; Dvorak of the Order Tribunal; Marianne of the Order Tribunal

Court Clerk: Order! Order in the court! All rise for the presiding judge and judicial officers to enter the court.

Court Clerk: Your Honor, the plaintiff, Thiago Montelli, the defendant, Tino Fisalia, and the defendant's attorney, Giuseppe, are now in court. The plaintiff's witness, Acolyte Nicolo, is waiting outside the court. Preparations for the final trial have been completed. The trial may begin, Your Honor.

Presiding Judge: According to the doctrines and regulations of the Order, the 10th Court of the Order Tribunal of Tidal Sanctuary, the Order of the Deep in Ragunna, shall preside over the dispute between the plaintiff, the Montelli family, and the defendants, Tino Fisalia and the Fisalia family. I hereby declare the court is now in session.

Presiding Judge: We will now establish the basic information of the parties and their counsel. If there are no objections from either side, we will proceed with the inquiry and examine the disputed claims, evidence, and witnesses presented by both parties.

source_en:
...
Presiding Judge: Witness, do you affirm that the testimony provided by the plaintiff in the complaint is truthful?

Witness: It is not truthful.

Presiding Judge: Order!

Presiding Judge: Witness Acolyte Nicolo, I ask you again, is the testimony provided by the plaintiff in the complaint accurate? Be advised, under the Tribunal's rules, any contradictions in your testimony, should they affect the outcome of this trial, may lead to charges of perjury!

Witness: Your Honor, by the Sentinel above, I admit that my prior testimony was false. I request that the Tribunal provide witness protection for myself and my family. I testify that the Montelli family coerced me into making a false statement in court.
 
Plaintiff: What madness is this, Nicolo?! What did the Fisalias say to you before the trial?
 
Defendant: Heh.
 
Presiding Judge: Order!
 
Presiding Judge: Order in the court! Given the witness's retraction of his testimony, the Order Tribunal shall now resume the examination process. The panel of judges will review the claims, the evidence, and the testimony presented. The trial will reconvene tomorrow at noon, at which time the verdict will be rendered. The court is adjourned.

Court Clerk: All rise for the presiding judge and judicial officers to depart. All parties and spectators may now exit the courtroom.

The Employee Manual for all staff members of the Averardo Vault. Below is the content from the first page:

Welcome to the Averardo Vault. Your arrival brings fresh energy to the Vault, and we sincerely look forward to your exceptional performance.

In keeping with the principle of "the sanctity and inviolability of private property," the Averardo Vault houses a vast collection of priceless Echoes and artworks. It is the safest and most secure place in Rinascita. Your every word and action reflect the Vault's image, and we trust this manual will help you gain a comprehensive understanding of the Averardo Vault.

Vault Overview:

The Vault is located east of Ragunna City, where it stores a vast array of Echoes and artworks. The Vault is divided into two zones: the Upper Management Zone, positioned above a chasm with a commanding view of the sea of clouds, and the Underground Depository Zone, situated beneath the clouds and connected to the upper zone by an elevator tower.

The Vault's security system is comprised of Echoes.

source_en:
A poster advertising tourism in Riccioli Islands

Discover Riccioli Islands, a hidden paradise nestled amidst Rinascita's turbulent waters.
Named after the renowned astronomer and seafarer of the Order, Sir Riccioli, this archipelago has been a sanctuary of natural wonders since its discovery during Rinascita's founding years. From the elusive Riccioli Black Pearls to the ethereal Stygian Phantoms and strange Yarn Eels, the archipelago is teeming with life and natural beauties thanks to the unique qualities of its geographic location with much more yet to be discovered.

While Cetus is revered for its role in ferrying sailors' souls to the afterlife, the Stygian Phantom is said to deliver lost souls to the Underworld ruled by the Overlord Squid, where they remain trapped for eternity.

source_en: Often found alongside the Stygian Phantom, this fish is said to carry the souls of lost sailors who have entered the domain of the Underworld. Fishers hold that these souls are even beyond the reach of Cetus the Tidebreaker, eternally adrift, never to find rest.
new_translation_vi: Often found alongside the Stygian Phantom, this fish is said to carry the souls of lost sailors who have entered the domain of the Underworld. Fishers hold that these souls are even beyond the reach of Cetus the Tidebreaker, eternally adrift, never to find rest.

source_en: During the breeding season, some ocean trenches experience a Seabed Snow population explosion, turning the seabed into a pristine white landscape adorned with vibrant flowers—a truly picturesque sight to behold.
new_translation_vi: During the breeding season, some ocean trenches experience a Seabed Snow population explosion, turning the seabed into a pristine white landscape adorned with vibrant flowers—a truly picturesque sight to behold.

source_en: A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. The origin, structure, and power force of this mysterious mechanical device are all shrouded in mystery. Could it hail from a world where humans can be transformed into machines, robots talk, airships dominate the skies, and fish are made of iron? What? You want to know why the oceans there are red?
new_translation_vi: A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. The origin, structure, and power force of this mysterious mechanical device are all shrouded in mystery. Could it hail from a world where humans can be transformed into machines, robots talk, airships dominate the skies, and fish are made of iron? What? You want to know why the oceans there are red?

source_en: A dreamy creature found in the ocean trenches, like a cute tiny elf. Its survival hinges on extremely specific conditions, making it impossible to sell as an ornamental pet in Ragunna.
new_translation_vi: A dreamy creature found in the ocean trenches, like a cute tiny elf. Its survival hinges on extremely specific conditions, making it impossible to sell as an ornamental pet in Ragunna.

source_en: Captain Ahab and Bertoli, a biologist from the Pioneer Association, once had a heated debate over the name of this fish. Ahab insisted that its fondness for sunbathing warranted the name "Sunfish," to which Bertoli retorted, "Then why not just call it 'Dried Flatfish' instead?"
new_translation_vi: Captain Ahab and Bertoli, a biologist from the Pioneer Association, once had a heated debate over the name of this fish. Ahab insisted that its fondness for sunbathing warranted the name "Sunfish," to which Bertoli retorted, "Then why not just call it 'Dried Flatfish' instead?"

source_en: This vibrant red shrimp has an intimidating name, but its flavor tells a different story. Renowned for its exquisite taste, some food enthusiasts believe the name "Legilimens Shrimp" stems from its ability to captivate anyone who takes just one bite.
new_translation_vi: This vibrant red shrimp has an intimidating name, but its flavor tells a different story. Renowned for its exquisite taste, some food enthusiasts believe the name "Legilimens Shrimp" stems from its ability to captivate anyone who takes just one bite.

source_en: A top predator in the oceanic waters surrounding the Riccioli Islands, the Lancetfish is known for its fiery temper. Once it sinks its teeth into prey, it never lets go, swallowing its victim whole. This habit has led to frequent catches of Lancetfish that died from attempting to devour a Trombone Ammonoid—shells and all.
new_translation_vi: A top predator in the oceanic waters surrounding the Riccioli Islands, the Lancetfish is known for its fiery temper. Once it sinks its teeth into prey, it never lets go, swallowing its victim whole. This habit has led to frequent catches of Lancetfish that died from attempting to devour a Trombone Ammonoid—shells and all.

source_en: This peculiar fish always "stands" on the seabed with its three slender fins. Its primary diet consists of Seabed Snows, but these poor little deep-sea bunnies occasionally try to climb its fins for a counterattack. Alas, their attempts are always in vain.
new_translation_vi: This peculiar fish always "stands" on the seabed with its three slender fins. Its primary diet consists of Seabed Snows, but these poor little deep-sea bunnies occasionally try to climb its fins for a counterattack. Alas, their attempts are always in vain.

source_en: Painters in Ragunna once tried to extract the vivid hues of the Rainbow Dolphinfish for their artwork but abandoned the idea when the pigments proved impossible to blend. This type of dolphinfish carries its offspring while hunting and is fiercely protective. If its young are threatened, it will retaliate without hesitation, even capsizing fishing ships—hence the nickname "Iron Lady."
new_translation_vi: Painters in Ragunna once tried to extract the vivid hues of the Rainbow Dolphinfish for their artwork but abandoned the idea when the pigments proved impossible to blend. This type of dolphinfish carries its offspring while hunting and is fiercely protective. If its young are threatened, it will retaliate without hesitation, even capsizing fishing ships—hence the nickname "Iron Lady."

source_en: As a rare survivor of the last Lament, their shell is revered by the Order of the Deep as a sacred material for crafting instruments. Yet, with natural predators at every turn, their numbers in the Riccioli waters are dwindling rapidly.
new_translation_vi: As a rare survivor of the last Lament, their shell is revered by the Order of the Deep as a sacred material for crafting instruments. Yet, with natural predators at every turn, their numbers in the Riccioli waters are dwindling rapidly.

source_en: A colossal hairtail that can stretch several meters in length, the Reinfish is a legendary creature in the Riccioli Islands. According to local lore, it serves as the reins of the sea god's chariot. In Ragunna, however, its appearance is seen as an omen of an impending earthquake. Like the Lancetfish, the Reinfish reigns as a top predator in the oceanic waters of the Riccioli Islands.
new_translation_vi: A colossal hairtail that can stretch several meters in length, the Reinfish is a legendary creature in the Riccioli Islands. According to local lore, it serves as the reins of the sea god's chariot. In Ragunna, however, its appearance is seen as an omen of an impending earthquake. Like the Lancetfish, the Reinfish reigns as a top predator in the oceanic waters of the Riccioli Islands.

source_en: A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands.  Legend has it that this shark only preys on pirates attempting to bury their treasures, devouring them whole along with their gold. Recently, the Aureo Shark has been hunting a notorious pirate named Aldric, who narrowly escaped its jaws—until fate brought it to your fishing boat instead.
new_translation_vi: A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands.  Legend has it that this shark only preys on pirates attempting to bury their treasures, devouring them whole along with their gold. Recently, the Aureo Shark has been hunting a notorious pirate named Aldric, who narrowly escaped its jaws—until fate brought it to your fishing boat instead.

source_en: A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. Legend has it that during Napolis the Second's pilgrimage, a storm arose. To calm the tempest, a pink sacred relic was cast into the raging sea, restoring the waters to their former tranquility. An ordinary ray fish happened to pass by the relic and was imbued with its pink hue.
new_translation_vi: A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. Legend has it that during Napolis the Second's pilgrimage, a storm arose. To calm the tempest, a pink sacred relic was cast into the raging sea, restoring the waters to their former tranquility. An ordinary ray fish happened to pass by the relic and was imbued with its pink hue.

source_en: A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. This rare, colossal sea dragon was once believed extinct until it was spotted in the depths of the Riccioli Trench. Locals of the Riccioli Islands believe it to be a guardian of the sea, akin to Cetus the Tidebreaker. In the scriptures of the Order of the Deep, the Pelagic Wrym is deemed a harbinger of the Sentinel's manifestation.
new_translation_vi: A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. This rare, colossal sea dragon was once believed extinct until it was spotted in the depths of the Riccioli Trench. Locals of the Riccioli Islands believe it to be a guardian of the sea, akin to Cetus the Tidebreaker. In the scriptures of the Order of the Deep, the Pelagic Wrym is deemed a harbinger of the Sentinel's manifestation.

source_en: A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. It is said that after Threnodian Leviathan was defeated by Sentinel Imperator, its subordinates were stripped of their power, left to barely survive in the depths. Draco Cobia, once a loyal servant of the Leviathan, has long lost the power granted by the Threnodian, yet it still remains a deadly predator to smaller sea creatures.
new_translation_vi: Một sinh vật huyền thoại, một trong những bá chủ của vùng biển tại quần đảo Riccioli. Người ta kể rằng sau khi Threnodian Leviathan bị Sentinel Imperator đánh bại, các thuộc hạ của nó đã bị tước đoạt sức mạnh và phải chật vật sinh tồn dưới đáy sâu. Draco Cobia, từng là một bề tôi trung thành của Leviathan, từ lâu đã mất đi sức mạnh được ban tặng bởi Threnodian, nhưng nó vẫn là một kẻ săn mồi đáng gờm đối với các sinh vật biển nhỏ hơn.

source_en:
A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands.
"In the Underworld palace, the archdemon sits on its throne, awaiting souls delivered by the ferryman. With a thousand grasping arms, it rises to seize the heart of the condemned. From that moment, the wretched soul is bound to serve the archdemon for a thousand years, a fate from which neither Cetus the Tidebreaker nor Imperator can deliver them."
new_translation_vi: Một sinh vật huyền thoại, một trong những bá chủ của vùng biển tại quần đảo Riccioli.

source_en: A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. This creature is a top predator who has survived thousands of years in the oceanic waters of the Riccioli Islands. Surviving the Lament might sound impressive, but facing its razor-sharp fangs is an even greater challenge.
new_translation_vi: Một sinh vật huyền thoại, một trong những bá chủ của vùng biển tại quần đảo Riccioli. Sinh vật này là kẻ săn mồi đỉnh cao đã sống sót qua hàng ngàn năm trong vùng nước đại dương của quần đảo Riccioli. Sống sót qua Lament nghe có vẻ ấn tượng, nhưng đối mặt với hàm răng sắc như dao cạo của nó còn là một thử thách lớn hơn nhiều.

source_en:
What's the difference between a coconut-flavored urchin and an urchin-flavored coconut? Nevertheless, one thing's for sure: both hurt like a charm when they hit your head.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Sự khác biệt giữa một con nhím biển vị dừa và một quả dừa vị nhím biển là gì? Dù sao thì, có một điều chắc chắn: cả hai đều đau điếng khi đập vào đầu bạn.

source_en:
As is well known, octopuses don't naturally grow inside clams. These small octopuses actively seek out suitable clams, devour the original residents, and claim the shells as their new homes.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Như mọi người đều biết, bạch tuộc không tự nhiên lớn lên bên trong vỏ ngao. Những con bạch tuộc nhỏ này chủ động tìm kiếm những vỏ ngao phù hợp, ăn thịt cư dân ban đầu và chiếm lấy vỏ làm ngôi nhà mới.

source_en:
During their brief breeding season, Bell Crabs shed their iconic bells in search of mates. Fishers humorously call them "Bell-less Crabs" during this time. Their meat is said to become exceptionally flavorful, attracting food enthusiasts from Ragunna eager to savor this seasonal delicacy.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Trong mùa sinh sản ngắn ngủi, Bell Crab sẽ rụng đi chiếc chuông đặc trưng của chúng để tìm kiếm bạn tình. Ngư dân gọi vui chúng là "Cua không chuông" trong thời gian này. Thịt của chúng được cho là trở nên đặc biệt thơm ngon, thu hút những người sành ăn từ Ragunna háo hức thưởng thức món đặc sản theo mùa này.

source_en:
Found across Solaris, this fish occupies a mid-tier position in the food chain. It is known for its ability to leap out of the water and glide for short distances.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Được tìm thấy trên khắp Solaris, loài cá này chiếm vị trí trung bình trong chuỗi thức ăn. Nó nổi tiếng với khả năng nhảy ra khỏi mặt nước và lướt đi trong những khoảng cách ngắn.

source_en:
True to its name, this jellyfish resembles and tastes like a fried egg. It is one of the largest exports of the Riccioli Islands.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Đúng như tên gọi, loài sứa này trông giống và có vị như một quả trứng chiên. Đây là một trong những mặt hàng xuất khẩu lớn nhất của quần đảo Riccioli.

source_en:
Are they fish? Yes, yes, they are. Did I finish them? No, no...

<color=#b9b9b9>Their form seems to have been twisted by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Their altered appearance exhibits striking differences from their native form, making them a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Chúng có phải là cá không? Vâng, đúng vậy. Tôi đã ăn hết chúng chưa? Chưa, chưa...

source_en:
At a distance, it resembles a drifting vegetable leaf, but up close, it brings to mind the legendary ancient dragon of Rinascita. Despite their grand dreams of becoming the mighty Pelagic Wyrm, their tiny size dooms their ambition to stay only a fantasy.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Từ xa, nó trông giống như một chiếc lá rau trôi dạt, nhưng khi nhìn gần, nó gợi nhớ đến loài rồng cổ đại huyền thoại của Rinascita. Mặc dù có giấc mơ lớn lao là trở thành Pelagic Wyrm hùng mạnh, nhưng kích thước nhỏ bé đã khiến tham vọng của chúng chỉ mãi là ảo tưởng.

source_en:
Most biologists in Rinascita agree that "Rainbow Eel" would better suit this creature than "Yarn Eel" based on their vibrant appearance. However, due to their timid nature, these eels are often found tangling with one another for survival. While "a cluster of timid Rainbow Eels" might be accurate, "Yarn Eel" is far less of a tongue-twister.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Hầu hết các nhà sinh học ở Rinascita đều đồng ý rằng "Lươn Cầu Vồng" sẽ phù hợp với sinh vật này hơn là "Lươn Len" dựa trên vẻ ngoài rực rỡ của chúng. Tuy nhiên, do bản tính nhút nhát, những con lươn này thường quấn lấy nhau để sinh tồn. Mặc dù "một cụm Lươn Cầu Vồng nhút nhát" có thể chính xác, nhưng "Lươn Len" lại dễ gọi hơn nhiều.

source_en:
This octopus might not pack much nutritional value, but its charm is off the charts. With a cute appearance and a soft, graceful body that dances through the water, it has won the hearts of Ragunna's noble ladies, becoming a sought-after ornamental pet.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Loài bạch tuộc này có thể không mang nhiều giá trị dinh dưỡng, nhưng sức hút của nó thì không thể bàn cãi. Với vẻ ngoài dễ thương cùng cơ thể mềm mại, uyển chuyển nhảy múa dưới nước, nó đã chiếm trọn trái tim của các quý cô quý tộc tại Ragunna, trở thành một thú cưng trang trí được săn đón.

source_en:
In the Riccioli Islands, misbehaving children are often warned about the Giant Gulper, a deep-sea predator said to snatch naughty kids at night. While this creature fuels many childhood nightmares for the islanders, the Sob Blobs, as its helpless prey, truly live in its shadow.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Tại quần đảo Riccioli, trẻ em hư thường bị dọa bởi Giant Gulper, một kẻ săn mồi dưới đáy sâu được cho là sẽ bắt cóc những đứa trẻ nghịch ngợm vào ban đêm. Trong khi sinh vật này là nỗi ác mộng thời thơ ấu của người dân trên đảo, thì Sob Blob, với tư cách là con mồi bất lực của nó, thực sự đang sống dưới cái bóng của nó.

source_en:
In the lightless depths of the sea, these clustered salps are a common meal for many deep-sea creatures—except Giant Gulpers. It seems these predators find the salps too small to bother with. To date, there have been no reported sightings of Giant Gulpers chowing down on salps.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Trong những tầng sâu không ánh sáng của đại dương, những cụm salp này là bữa ăn phổ biến của nhiều sinh vật biển sâu—ngoại trừ Giant Gulper. Có vẻ như những kẻ săn mồi này thấy salp quá nhỏ để bận tâm. Cho đến nay, chưa có báo cáo nào về việc Giant Gulper ăn salp.

source_en:
It sobs for its insignificance in the vast ocean and its vulnerability to the gaping maw of its predators.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Nó nức nở vì sự nhỏ bé của mình giữa đại dương bao la và sự dễ bị tổn thương trước cái miệng rộng ngoác của những kẻ săn mồi.

source_en:
The Pokey Moray once vowed to leave behind its slow-paced life—only for its ambition to be cut short the moment it ended up on your line.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Pokey Moray từng thề sẽ leave đằng sau cuộc sống nhịp độ slow của mình—chỉ để tham vọng đó bị cắt đứt ngay khoảnh khắc nó mắc vào lưỡi câu của bạn.

source_en:
Food, shelter, and fashion are no concerns for a Gooberstar. It spends its days lounging in carefree bliss, untouched by predators thanks to its unappetizing taste. Its life is nearly perfect—if only it could find a sponge to make things even better.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Thức ăn, nơi ở và thời trang không phải là mối bận tâm của Gooberstar. Nó dành cả ngày để thư giãn trong sự hạnh phúc vô tư, không bị kẻ săn mồi đụng đến nhờ hương vị khó ăn của mình. Cuộc sống của nó gần như hoàn hảo—giá như nó có thể tìm thấy một miếng bọt biển để mọi thứ trở nên tuyệt vời hơn.

source_en:
Armed with a coat of sharp thorns, a Pricklecrab is a bold and aggressive predator of the deep sea. One fisher is said to have fended off a Tacet Discord by hurling a Pricklecrab at it. A creature of great ferocity indeed.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Được trang bị lớp gai sắc nhọn, Pricklecrab là một kẻ săn mồi táo bạo và hung dữ dưới đáy biển sâu. Người ta kể rằng một ngư dân đã đẩy lùi được Tacet Discord bằng cách ném một con Pricklecrab vào nó. Quả là một sinh vật đầy hung dữ.

source_en:
Known as the "Sea Angel," this delicate creature is as enchanting as a butterfly fairy. Many believe it serves as the envoy of Cetus the Tidebreaker, tasked with retrieving lost souls from the ocean's depths. Yet, given its diminutive size, one can't help but question its suitability for such a daunting mission.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Được mệnh danh là "Thiên thần biển", sinh vật tinh tế này quyến rũ như một nàng tiên bướm. Nhiều người tin rằng nó đóng vai trò là sứ giả của Cetus the Tidebreaker, được giao nhiệm vụ tìm lại những linh hồn lạc lối từ đáy đại dương. Tuy nhiên, với kích thước nhỏ bé như vậy, người ta không khỏi nghi ngờ về khả năng thực hiện một nhiệm vụ khó khăn như thế.

source_en:
These ancient sea flowers thrive in Solaris, fostering a harmonious bond with Seabed Snows. Their appearance resembles the decorative feathers often seen on performers' hats during the Carnevale, earning them the nickname "Star's Feather Crown."

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Những bông hoa biển cổ đại này phát triển mạnh trong Solaris, tạo nên mối liên kết hài hòa với Seabed Snow. Vẻ ngoài của chúng giống như những chiếc lông vũ trang trí thường thấy trên mũ của các nghệ sĩ trong Carnevale, mang lại cho chúng biệt danh "Vương miện lông vũ của sao".

source_en:
The Stygian Phantom, a highly toxic jellyfish cherished by the Fisalia family, stands in stark contrast to Cetus the Tidebreaker. While Cetus is revered for its role in ferrying sailors' souls to the afterlife, the Stygian Phantom is said to deliver lost souls to the Underworld ruled by the Overlord Squid, where they remain trapped for eternity.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Stygian Phantom, một loài sứa cực độc được gia đình Fisalia yêu quý, hoàn toàn trái ngược với Cetus the Tidebreaker. Trong khi Cetus được tôn kính vì vai trò đưa linh hồn thủy thủ sang thế giới bên kia, thì Stygian Phantom được cho là sẽ đưa những linh hồn lạc lối đến Địa ngục do Overlord Squid cai trị, nơi họ bị mắc kẹt mãi mãi.

source_en:
Often found alongside the Stygian Phantom, this fish is said to carry the souls of lost sailors who have entered the domain of the Underworld. Fishers hold that these souls are even beyond the reach of Cetus the Tidebreaker, eternally adrift, never to find rest.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Thường được tìm thấy cùng với Stygian Phantom, loài cá này được cho là mang theo linh hồn của những thủy thủ lạc lối đã bước vào lãnh địa của Địa ngục. Ngư dân tin rằng những linh hồn này thậm chí còn nằm ngoài tầm với của Cetus the Tidebreaker, mãi mãi trôi dạt, không bao giờ tìm thấy sự an nghỉ.

source_en:
During its breeding season, some ocean trenches experience a population explosion of Seabed Snows, turning the seabed into a pristine white landscape adorned with vibrant flowers—a truly picturesque sight to behold.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Trong mùa sinh sản, một số rãnh đại dương trải qua sự bùng nổ dân số của Seabed Snow, biến đáy biển thành một khung cảnh trắng tinh khôi được tô điểm bởi những bông hoa rực rỡ—một cảnh tượng thực sự đẹp như tranh vẽ.

source_en:
If you ever venture into the depths of the Riccioli waters, beware of any glimmers in the darkness—no matter how enchanting their colors.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Nếu bạn từng mạo hiểm vào sâu trong vùng nước Riccioli, hãy cẩn thận với bất kỳ ánh sáng nào trong bóng tối—bất kể màu sắc của chúng có mê hoặc đến đâu.

source_en: A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. The origin, structure, and power force of this mysterious mechanical device are all shrouded in mystery. Could it hail from a world where humans can be transformed into machines, robots talk, airships dominate the skies, and fish are made of iron? What? You want to know why the oceans there are red?
new_translation_vi: Một sinh vật huyền thoại, một trong những bá chủ của vùng biển tại quần đảo Riccioli. Nguồn gốc, cấu trúc và lực lượng sức mạnh của thiết bị cơ khí bí ẩn này đều bị bao phủ trong bí ẩn. Liệu nó có đến từ một thế giới nơi con người có thể biến thành máy móc, robot biết nói, khí cầu thống trị bầu trời và cá được làm bằng sắt? Cái gì? Bạn muốn biết tại sao đại dương ở đó lại có màu đỏ ư?

source_en:
A dreamy creature found in the ocean trenches, like a cute tiny elf. Its survival hinges on extremely specific conditions, making it impossible to sell as an ornamental pet in Ragunna.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Một sinh vật mơ mộng được tìm thấy trong các rãnh đại dương, giống như một yêu tinh nhỏ dễ thương. Sự sống sót của nó phụ thuộc vào các điều kiện cực kỳ cụ thể, khiến nó không thể bán làm thú cưng trang trí ở Ragunna.

source_en:
Captain Ahab and Bertoli, a biologist from the Pioneer Association, once had a heated debate over the name of this fish. Ahab insisted that its fondness for sunbathing warranted the name "Sunfish," to which Bertoli retorted, "Then why not just call it 'Dried Flatfish' instead?"

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Thuyền trưởng Ahab và Bertoli, một nhà sinh học từ Hiệp hội Tiên phong, từng có một cuộc tranh luận gay gắt về tên của loài cá này. Ahab khẳng định rằng sở thích tắm nắng của nó xứng đáng với cái tên "Cá mặt trời", để rồi Bertoli đáp trả: "Vậy tại sao không gọi nó là 'Cá bẹt khô' cho xong?"

source_en:
This vibrant red shrimp has an intimidating name, but its flavor tells a different story. Renowned for its exquisite taste, some food enthusiasts believe the name "Legilimens Shrimp" stems from its ability to captivate anyone who takes just one bite.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Loài tôm đỏ rực rỡ này có một cái tên đáng sợ, nhưng hương vị của nó lại kể một câu chuyện khác. Nổi tiếng với hương vị tinh tế, một số người sành ăn tin rằng cái tên "Tôm Legilimens" bắt nguồn từ khả năng mê hoặc bất cứ ai chỉ sau một miếng cắn.

source_en:
A top predator in the oceanic waters surrounding the Riccioli Islands, the Lancetfish is known for its fiery temper. Once it sinks its teeth into prey, it never lets go, swallowing its victim whole. This habit has led to frequent catches of Lancetfish that died from attempting to devour a Trombone Ammonoid—shells and all.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Là kẻ săn mồi đỉnh cao ở vùng nước đại dương bao quanh quần đảo Riccioli, Lancetfish nổi tiếng với tính khí nóng nảy. Một khi đã cắm răng vào con mồi, nó không bao giờ buông tha, nuốt chửng nạn nhân. Thói quen này dẫn đến việc thường xuyên bắt được những con Lancetfish chết vì cố gắng nuốt chửng một con Trombone Ammonoid—cả vỏ lẫn thịt.

source_en:
Wait, is that... Astrite!? Holy crab!!

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Khoan đã, đó là... Astrite!? Ôi chao ôi!!

source_en:
This peculiar fish always "stands" on the seabed with its three slender fins. Its primary diet consists of Seabed Snows, but these poor little deep-sea bunnies occasionally try to climb its fins for a counterattack. Alas, their attempts are always in vain.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Loài cá kỳ lạ này luôn "đứng" trên đáy biển bằng ba chiếc vây mảnh khảnh. Chế độ ăn chính của nó bao gồm Seabed Snow, nhưng những chú thỏ biển nhỏ bé tội nghiệp này đôi khi cố gắng leo lên vây của nó để phản công. Than ôi, những nỗ lực của chúng luôn vô ích.

source_en:
Painters in Ragunna once tried to extract the vivid hues of the Rainbow Dolphinfish for their artwork but abandoned the idea when the pigments proved impossible to blend. This type of dolphinfish carries its offspring while hunting and is fiercely protective. If its young are threatened, it will retaliate without hesitation, even capsizing fishing ships—hence the nickname "Iron Lady."

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Các họa sĩ ở Ragunna từng cố gắng chiết xuất những sắc thái sống động của Rainbow Dolphinfish cho tác phẩm nghệ thuật của họ nhưng đã từ bỏ ý định khi các sắc tố không thể pha trộn. Loài cá heo này mang theo con non khi đi săn và bảo vệ chúng rất quyết liệt. Nếu con non bị đe dọa, nó sẽ trả đũa không chút do dự, thậm chí lật úp cả tàu đánh cá—do đó mới có biệt danh là "Bà đầm thép".

source_en:
As a rare survivor of the last Lament, their shell is revered by the Order of the Deep as a sacred material for crafting instruments. Yet, with natural predators at every turn, their numbers in the Riccioli waters are dwindling rapidly.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Là một loài sống sót hiếm hoi sau đợt Lament cuối cùng, vỏ của chúng được Order of the Deep tôn kính như một vật liệu thiêng liêng để chế tác nhạc cụ. Tuy nhiên, với những kẻ săn mồi tự nhiên luôn rình rập, số lượng của chúng ở vùng nước Riccioli đang giảm dần nhanh chóng.

source_en:
A colossal hairtail that can stretch several meters in length, the Reinfish is a legendary creature in the Riccioli Islands. According to local lore, it serves as the reins of the sea god's chariot. In Ragunna, however, its appearance is seen as an omen of an impending earthquake. Like the Lancetfish, the Reinfish reigns as a top predator in the oceanic waters of the Riccioli Islands.

<color=#b9b9b9>This mutant variant seems to have been affected by the conflicting forces of the Sentinel and the Threnodian. Its altered appearance exhibits striking differences from the wild type, making it a captivating prize for collectors willing to pay a hefty price.</color>
new_translation_vi: Là một loài cá hố khổng lồ có thể dài tới vài mét, Reinfish là một sinh vật huyền thoại ở quần đảo Riccioli. Theo truyền thuyết địa phương, nó đóng vai trò là dây cương cho cỗ xe của thần biển. Tuy nhiên, ở Ragunna, sự xuất hiện của nó được coi là điềm báo về một trận động đất sắp xảy ra. Giống như Lancetfish, Reinfish thống trị như một kẻ săn mồi đỉnh cao ở vùng nước đại dương của quần đảo Riccioli.

source_en:
[About]

After a decade of anticipation, the long-awaited Carnevale has reignited a fiery passion that refuses to fade.

The Water City has just unveiled a corner of its secrets. Now is the best time to set sail, ride the winds, and venture into the uncharted corners of this mysterious land.

With the world's curtain lifting, a new exploration calls—why wait? Dive into the adventure now!

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 22 and unlock Utility: Flight.

[Event Rules]

1. During the event, you can invite other players to join the Overdash Challenge in Co-op Mode. The first to finish is the winner.

2. Once the first player finishes, the challenge enters a 20-second final sprint phase. After the sprint phase ends, results will be finalized.

3. Combat is disabled during the challenge. Players must follow the markers to finish the challenge.

4. The final points consist of two parts: Course Completion Points and Ranking Points:

I. Course Completion Points are earned by reaching designated checkpoints along the track.

II. Ranking Points are earned based on the order in which players finish.

[Reminder]

Resonators of different heights run at different speeds.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
A meticulously preserved Ammonoid fossil. Little Brant once stood atop a table, proudly declaring to his father that he had found a treasure hidden among the books. His father took off his glasses for a closer look, recognizing it as the Ammonoid fossil tucked away at the bottom of the bookshelf. Seizing the moment, his father recounted an adventure about unearthing the past and seeking the truth.

That Ammonoid became Brant's first treasure and marked the beginning of his journey into a world of endless adventure.
new_translation_vi: Một hóa thạch Ammonoid được bảo quản tỉ mỉ. Brant nhỏ từng đứng trên bàn, tự hào tuyên bố với cha mình rằng cậu đã tìm thấy một kho báu ẩn giấu giữa những cuốn sách. Người cha tháo kính ra để nhìn kỹ hơn, nhận ra đó là hóa thạch Ammonoid được cất ở dưới cùng của giá sách. Nắm bắt khoảnh khắc đó, người cha kể lại một cuộc phiêu lưu về việc khai quật quá khứ và tìm kiếm sự thật.

source_en:
A sculpture of stacked masks, each crafted for a different play and occasion.

On stage, he is the star, the center of all eyes. With each mask, he breathes life into the tale, captivating the audience with joy and wonder. But offstage, there is no need to conceal his true self.

In that moment, he is, at last, simply Brant.
new_translation_vi: Một tác phẩm điêu khắc gồm những chiếc mặt nạ xếp chồng lên nhau, mỗi chiếc được chế tác cho một vở kịch và dịp khác nhau.

source_en:
A locket Phoebe carries with her, repurposed from an old pocket watch. Inside is a family portrait. 

It was lost to the depths of the sea during a shipwreck, but thanks to the tireless search of her kind friends, it was eventually returned to her.

"In the fleeting waves of time... in the beautiful spray of the sea, and in the light, there are words I want to tell you, over and over again."
new_translation_vi: Một chiếc mề đay mà Phoebe luôn mang theo bên mình, được tái chế từ một chiếc đồng hồ bỏ túi cũ. Bên trong là ảnh gia đình.

source_en:
A handcrafted souvenir from a land across the sea was the only item Phoebe kept when her family's possessions were sold off.

In the bedtime stories she once believed would never end, there was a bird with blue wings, the envoy of the Divinity. It had the power to cross through storms and bring happiness to the little girl who endured loneliness each night as she drifted to sleep.
new_translation_vi: Một món quà lưu niệm thủ công từ một vùng đất bên kia đại dương là món đồ duy nhất Phoebe giữ lại khi tài sản của gia đình cô bị bán hết.

source_en: Hey, here to see our performance? Take this ticket. No need to bring anything, just a smile and a heart full of excitement. But if you insist… Well, when I step on stage, be sure to give me all the applause and cheers you've got!
new_translation_vi: Này, đến xem buổi biểu diễn của chúng tôi à? Cầm lấy tấm vé này đi. Không cần mang theo gì cả, chỉ cần một nụ cười và trái tim đầy phấn khích là được. Nhưng nếu bạn cứ khăng khăng... Chà, khi tôi bước lên sân khấu, hãy nhớ dành cho tôi tất cả những tràng pháo tay và tiếng reo hò mà bạn có nhé!

source_en: All I think about on stage is losing myself in the role—the stage becomes "my" entire world, with every light, note, and movement telling "my" story. Up there, the world is my oyster. But once I step off, I'm just a minor character in the tale of <ano=the world>Solaris</ano>.
new_translation_vi: Tất cả những gì tôi nghĩ đến trên sân khấu là đắm mình vào vai diễn—sân khấu trở thành cả thế giới "của tôi", với mỗi ánh đèn, nốt nhạc và chuyển động đều kể câu chuyện "của tôi". Ở trên đó, thế giới là của tôi. Nhưng một khi bước xuống, tôi chỉ là một nhân vật phụ trong câu chuyện của <ano=thế giới>Solaris</ano>.

source_en: The boundless sea is the grandest stage, its towering waves our most thunderous applause! We sail with the currents and winds, hunting for cheers and laughter on every distant shore. Therefore, my friend, lift your voice and dance with abandon—for you, for me, and for every day we have lived in full!
new_translation_vi: Đại dương bao la là sân khấu vĩ đại nhất, những con sóng cao vút là tràng pháo tay vang dội nhất của chúng tôi! Chúng tôi dong buồm theo dòng hải lưu và những cơn gió, săn tìm tiếng reo hò và tiếng cười trên mọi bờ xa. Vì vậy, bạn của tôi, hãy cất tiếng hát và nhảy múa hết mình—vì bạn, vì tôi và vì mỗi ngày chúng ta đã sống trọn vẹn!

source_en: Here, try this wine… A bit too sweet? Haha, that's just my "Strength!" Everyone's brew tastes different, you know. Battier's has a spicy edge, Tina's is rather refreshing. This is the Troupe's Strength… a blend of everyone's life.
new_translation_vi: Đây, thử loại rượu này xem... Hơi ngọt quá à? Haha, đó chỉ là "Sức mạnh!" của tôi thôi. Rượu của mỗi người đều có vị khác nhau mà. Của Battier thì có chút cay nồng, của Tina thì khá sảng khoái. Đây là Sức mạnh của Troupe... một sự pha trộn từ cuộc đời của mỗi người.

source_en: Take this telescope and see for yourself… Even the highest clouds feel close enough to touch, don't they? With this gadget, you'll catch every thrill onstage and every "new world" waiting out at sea.
new_translation_vi: Cầm lấy chiếc kính viễn vọng này và tự mình xem đi... Ngay cả những đám mây cao nhất cũng cảm thấy gần như có thể chạm tới, phải không? Với thiết bị này, bạn sẽ bắt trọn mọi sự hồi hộp trên sân khấu và mọi "thế giới mới" đang chờ đợi ngoài khơi xa.

source_en: Some call her a saint; others, a sinner. But who is she really? No one cares how she treats her friends or faces her foes. The Order's tales never speak of her dreams, and the legends conceal her heart's desire. Everyone has heard of Cartethyia—but does anyone know the person behind that name?
new_translation_vi: Một số người gọi cô là thánh, những người khác lại gọi là tội đồ. Nhưng cô thực sự là ai? Không ai quan tâm cô đối xử với bạn bè hay đối mặt với kẻ thù như thế nào. Những câu chuyện của Order không bao giờ nói về ước mơ của cô, và những huyền thoại che giấu khao khát trong trái tim cô. Ai cũng từng nghe về Cartethyia—nhưng có ai thực sự biết con người đằng sau cái tên đó không?

source_en: Happy birthday, my dear friend! Any plans for today? Would you like to go on a little adventure with me? I will even let you take the wheel. Here, hold on tight. Together, we will head for the distant horizon!
new_translation_vi: Chúc mừng sinh nhật, người bạn thân mến của tôi! Hôm nay có kế hoạch gì chưa? Bạn có muốn cùng tôi thực hiện một chuyến phiêu lưu nhỏ không? Tôi thậm chí sẽ để bạn cầm lái. Đây, giữ chặt nhé. Chúng ta sẽ cùng nhau hướng tới đường chân trời xa xôi!

source_en: Haha! Now this is the strength worthy of a true swordsman of the seas! Join me on this voyage to the world's end, my friend! Together, we'll face that fleeting moment when the world turns upside down!
new_translation_vi: Haha! Đây mới là sức mạnh xứng đáng với một kiếm sĩ thực thụ của biển cả! Hãy tham gia cùng tôi trong chuyến hải trình đến tận cùng thế giới này, bạn của tôi! Chúng ta sẽ cùng nhau đối mặt với khoảnh khắc thoáng qua khi thế giới đảo lộn!

source_en: Shhh.... how come you're all here? Ah, sorry {PlayerName}, didn't mean to disturb you. I just wanted to pay you a visit. Didn't expect these guys to tag along...
new_translation_vi: Suỵt.... sao mọi người lại ở đây hết vậy? À, xin lỗi {PlayerName}, tôi không có ý làm phiền bạn. Tôi chỉ muốn ghé thăm bạn thôi. Không ngờ mấy người này lại đi theo...

source_en: {PlayerName}, how did you meet Abby? Sorry, I don't mean to pry, it's just the two of you are inseparable, always looking out for each other, always trusting one another. It's wonderful, Abby must be... like family.
new_translation_vi: {PlayerName}, bạn gặp Abby như thế nào? Xin lỗi, tôi không có ý tò mò, chỉ là hai bạn không thể tách rời, luôn quan tâm đến nhau, luôn tin tưởng lẫn nhau. Thật tuyệt vời, Abby chắc hẳn... giống như gia đình vậy.

source_en: You always seem so busy, but I hardly ever see you resting... Are you, perhaps, having trouble sleeping? If that's the case, I can help. Just a little tap with my staff and your mind will be at ease... Hmm? Where are you going? It won't hurt at all...
new_translation_vi: Bạn lúc nào cũng có vẻ bận rộn, nhưng tôi hiếm khi thấy bạn nghỉ ngơi... Có phải bạn đang gặp khó khăn khi ngủ không? Nếu vậy, tôi có thể giúp. Chỉ cần một cái chạm nhẹ bằng cây trượng của tôi là tâm trí bạn sẽ thấy nhẹ nhõm... Hmm? Bạn đi đâu vậy? Nó sẽ không đau chút nào đâu...

source_en: When I was little, I loved going to Whisperwind Haven with friends. We'd lie on slopes surrounded by flowers and watch the clouds drift by. Tilly would play their accordion, and Livia and Brenno would weave all sorts of garlands that left a wonderful scent in their wake. I still go back sometimes... in secret.
new_translation_vi: Khi còn nhỏ, tôi thích đến Whisperwind Haven cùng bạn bè. Chúng tôi thường nằm trên những sườn đồi đầy hoa và ngắm nhìn những đám mây trôi qua. Tilly sẽ chơi đàn accordion, còn Livia và Brenno sẽ đan đủ loại vòng hoa tỏa hương thơm tuyệt vời. Đôi khi tôi vẫn quay lại đó... một cách bí mật.

source_en: I saw shadows where light could not reach. What if the path I once believed in so fervently was never the right one? Then... No, never mind. Please don't mind me...
new_translation_vi: Tôi đã nhìn thấy những cái bóng ở nơi ánh sáng không thể chạm tới. Nếu con đường tôi từng tin tưởng một cách mãnh liệt chưa bao giờ là con đường đúng đắn thì sao? Vậy thì... Không, không có gì. Xin đừng bận tâm đến tôi...

source_en: This locket was a gift from my father. I always thought it had sunk with that merchant ship, but here it is again in my hands. This itself is already a miracle... I cannot ask for more.
new_translation_vi: Chiếc mề đay này là món quà từ cha tôi. Tôi luôn nghĩ nó đã chìm cùng con tàu buôn đó, nhưng giờ nó lại nằm trong tay tôi. Bản thân điều này đã là một phép màu rồi... Tôi không thể đòi hỏi gì hơn nữa.

source_en: Mother once told me a story about an adventurer braving storms in search of freedom. When I saw Brant on stage, he reminded me of that adventurer, caring for naught while the ocean thrashes around him... Sometimes, I think Mr. Brant chooses to act out a life of equal parts comedy and tragedy.
new_translation_vi: Mẹ từng kể cho tôi nghe một câu chuyện về một nhà thám hiểm dũng cảm vượt bão để tìm kiếm tự do. Khi tôi thấy Brant trên sân khấu, anh ấy làm tôi nhớ đến nhà thám hiểm đó, chẳng màng đến gì cả trong khi đại dương gào thét xung quanh anh ấy... Đôi khi, tôi nghĩ ông Brant chọn diễn một cuộc đời vừa có hài kịch vừa có bi kịch.

source_en: ...I once dreamt of a black sea, with swells growing larger and more violent. Amidst the spray, the Blessed Maiden appeared—or at least I think it was her. Something in that swaying silhouette resembled her, yet it also felt so unlike her...
new_translation_vi: ...Tôi từng mơ về một vùng biển đen, với những con sóng ngày càng lớn và dữ dội hơn. Giữa làn bọt nước, Blessed Maiden xuất hiện—hoặc ít nhất tôi nghĩ là cô ấy. Có điều gì đó trong bóng hình đung đưa đó giống cô ấy, nhưng cũng cảm thấy rất khác với cô ấy...

source_en: Happy Birthday! Ooh... confetti! Just like how Mama and Papa used to celebrate. Here, take this, a bluebird set with aquamarine gemstones. A little something to be by your side through winds and storms. Like this statue, may your eyes always be bright, and may luck always be with you. Your path is not one ordained by the Sentinel, but one of your own making. And no matter where you go, I will always pray for you.
new_translation_vi: Chúc mừng sinh nhật! Ồ... pháo giấy! Giống hệt cách Mama và Papa từng ăn mừng. Đây, cầm lấy cái này, một chú chim xanh đính đá aquamarine. Một chút gì đó để ở bên cạnh bạn qua những cơn gió và bão tố. Giống như bức tượng này, mong rằng đôi mắt bạn luôn sáng ngời, và may mắn luôn ở bên bạn. Con đường

source_en:

<color=#929292>Its refined design reduces drag while trawling and makes it harder for fish to escape.</color>

source_en:
A hydro-jetting thruster. Add an extra use of Rachel's <color=#e7a60b>Acceleration</color>.

<color=#929292>This thruster is basically a supercharged water pump that helps Gondolas swim faster. You might even spot it on race-level Gondolas, giving them that extra burst of speed when they need it most.</color>
new_translation_vi: Một động cơ phản lực nước. Thêm một lần sử dụng <color=#e7a60b>Acceleration</color> cho Rachel.

source_en:
A mechanical capstan with multiple wheels that further boosts the <color=#e7a60b>fishing progress</color> of each fishing attempt.

<color=#929292>Being human means having limits, especially when it comes to reeling in giant sea creatures. That's why you'll need this device.</color>
new_translation_vi: Một tời cơ khí với nhiều bánh răng giúp tăng thêm <color=#e7a60b>tiến độ đánh bắt</color> cho mỗi lần câu.

source_en:
A professional fishing device for commercial fishing. It further boosts the <color=#e7a60b>fishing progress</color> of each fishing attempt.

<color=#929292>This massive device is great for big catches, but it might take some of the fun out of traditional angling.</color>
new_translation_vi: Một thiết bị câu cá chuyên nghiệp dành cho đánh bắt thương mại. Nó giúp tăng thêm <color=#e7a60b>tiến độ đánh bắt</color> cho mỗi lần câu.

source_en:
An additional engine room that greatly boosts <color=#e7a60b>fishing speed</color> and adds an extra use of Rachel's <color=#e7a60b>Acceleration</color>.

<color=#929292>This Gondola engine room not only revs up Rachel's speed but also powers more advanced fishing gear.</color>

source_en:
A tubular chamber installed on the ship to launch "Sweet Puffs." Equipped to unlock <color=#e7a60b>Bampuff</color> that blasts all Fishing Spots in a certain range and grants you the catches immediately. (Can be equipped via Utility wheel while sailing. Using it consumes "Sweet Puffs," which can be converted from Bampuffs.)

<color=#929292>Bampuffs are highly explosive and dangerous—both for the ship and the catches.</color>
new_translation_vi: Một ống phóng được lắp trên tàu để bắn "Sweet Puffs". Trang bị để mở khóa <color=#e7a60b>Bampuff</color>, giúp oanh tạc tất cả các Điểm Câu trong một phạm vi nhất định và thu hoạch cá ngay lập tức. (Có thể trang bị qua bánh xe Tiện ích khi đang chèo thuyền. Sử dụng sẽ tiêu tốn "Sweet Puffs", có thể đổi từ Bampuff.)

source_en:
An enhanced tube that improves the efficiency of <color=#e7a60b>Bampuffs</color>.

<color=#929292>With this tube, you can launch multiple "Sweet Puffs" in various directions with a bigger explosion range.</color>
new_translation_vi: Một ống phóng cải tiến giúp tăng hiệu quả của <color=#e7a60b>Bampuff</color>.

source_en:
An enhanced tube that improves the efficiency of <color=#e7a60b>Bampuffs</color>.

<color=#929292>This modification lets the tube launch "Sweet Puffs" to even farther areas, bombing those fleeing sea creatures with extra flair.</color>
new_translation_vi: Một ống phóng cải tiến giúp tăng hiệu quả của <color=#e7a60b>Bampuff</color>.

source_en:
Traditional bait used in the Riccioli Islands. Equipped to unlock <color=#e7a60b>Baiting</color>, which creates a Fishing Spot that yields larger quantities and higher-quality sea creatures you caught before in the area. (Can be equipped via Utility wheel while sailing. Using it consumes "Sandworms," which can be purchased at the dock shop.)

<color=#929292>Made using an ancient Riccioli recipe, this bait is highly effective. Just don't ask what's in it.</color>
new_translation_vi: Loại mồi truyền thống được sử dụng tại Quần đảo Riccioli. Trang bị để mở khóa <color=#e7a60b>Baiting</color>, tạo ra một Điểm Câu cho số lượng lớn hơn và chất lượng cao hơn các sinh vật biển bạn từng bắt được trong khu vực. (Có thể trang bị qua bánh xe Tiện ích khi đang chèo thuyền. Sử dụng sẽ tiêu tốn "Sandworms", có thể mua tại cửa hàng bến tàu.)

source_en:
The advanced bait that enables <color=#e7a60b>Baiting</color> to yield catches of higher quality.

<color=#929292>It's hard to imagine what kind of ingredients can make this pungent smell.</color>
new_translation_vi: Loại mồi cao cấp cho phép <color=#e7a60b>Baiting</color> thu hoạch được những mẻ cá chất lượng cao hơn.

source_en:
The advanced bait that enables <color=#e7a60b>Baiting</color> to yield catches of higher quality.

<color=#929292>This stuff is so gross that no sane human would touch it, but some sea creatures just can't resist.</color>
new_translation_vi: Loại mồi cao cấp cho phép <color=#e7a60b>Baiting</color> thu hoạch được những mẻ cá chất lượng cao hơn.

<color=#929292>Just like humans, Gondolas can grow stronger with regular training.</color>

new_translation_vi: Khóa huấn luyện sức mạnh đặc biệt dành cho Gondola. Huấn luyện Rachel để tăng thêm <color=#e7a60b>tốc độ chèo thuyền</color>.

source_en:
A worn student handbook, its pages frayed and torn, revealing only snippets of information.

Welcome to Avinoleum. This handbook serves as a guide for new students.

 1. The academy consists of three towers. In addition to the classrooms used for daily lessons, one tower is specifically dedicated to student gatherings and social events. This tower also houses portraits of past Primuses. Both new and old students are welcome to visit and pay their respects. Afterward, visitors must leave in an orderly manner.
 2. The watchtower and garden are only accessible before curfew. Entry is prohibited outside of these hours. Students are strictly forbidden from feeding the dragons that inhabit the surrounding area. Violators will face confinement for a period of three to five days.
new_translation_vi: Một cuốn sổ tay sinh viên cũ kỹ, các trang giấy đã sờn rách, chỉ còn lại vài mảnh thông tin rời rạc.

source_en:
3. Students who have completed the knighthood curriculum may apply to participate in the trials. Applications must be submitted with the required materials at least seven days in advance. A review process will follow, during which instructors will ensure applicants are not carrying any prohibited weapons or Echoes before proceeding to the trials.
4. The Path of Bestowal is only open to faculty and students during divine services and the Carnevale. Outside of the Carnevale, students invited to attend divine services must wear the prescribed attire and be accompanied by a member of the Order to the Path of Bestowal for their studies.
 
By the Sentinel above, may every student find enlightenment in Avinoleum.
new_translation_vi: 3. Sinh viên đã hoàn thành chương trình đào tạo hiệp sĩ có thể nộp đơn tham gia các thử thách. Đơn đăng ký phải được nộp kèm các tài liệu cần thiết ít nhất bảy ngày trước đó. Sau đó sẽ là quy trình xét duyệt, trong đó các giảng viên sẽ đảm bảo ứng viên không mang theo bất kỳ vũ khí hoặc Echo bị cấm nào trước khi tiến hành thử thách.

source_en:
A journal carried by a Fisalia member, detailing the principles and taboos that all must respect.

About the Family: Trust nothing blindly, not even your own kin. As a Fisalia, blessings and protection are earned by your own efforts. If you prove your worth, the family permits you to use any means necessary to rise. Even the position of family head is a treasure to be claimed at the right price. Betrayal is a tool, and greed is a virtue. But remember, always wield them with grace.

About Visiting: Every visit to the estate must be justified. For those who dare intrude without invitation, the Fisalias will show them the Fisalia way of hospitality. "Invite" them to leave, or "invite" them to stay permanently as a warning to others. When an invitation is extended, visitors must mind their manners and maintain discretion. Never allow curiosity or fear to lead to your undoing.
new_translation_vi: Một cuốn nhật ký của một thành viên Fisalia, ghi chép chi tiết các nguyên tắc và điều cấm kỵ mà tất cả phải tuân thủ.

source_en:
About the Castle: Visitors with matters to discuss must wait quietly in the reception room on the first floor until granted an audience with the family head. No wandering or departure is allowed during this time. Invited guests must present their invitations and proceed to the banquet hall on the right, where hospitality will be provided in accordance with their station. All other rooms in the mansion are off-limits for visitation, including but not limited to the study on the second floor and the surrounding garden.

About the Montellis: Fleeting brilliance. Remember, true glory belongs to the Fisalia family.
new_translation_vi: Về Lâu đài: Khách có việc cần thảo luận phải đợi lặng lẽ trong phòng tiếp khách ở tầng một cho đến khi được gia chủ tiếp kiến. Không được phép đi lại lung tung hoặc rời đi trong thời gian này. Khách được mời phải xuất trình thư mời và đi đến phòng tiệc bên phải, nơi sự hiếu khách sẽ được cung cấp phù hợp với địa vị của họ. Tất cả các phòng khác trong dinh thự đều không được phép tham quan, bao gồm nhưng không giới hạn ở phòng làm việc trên tầng hai và khu vườn xung quanh.
