source_en:
The current head of <te href=850094>Fisalia</te>, Cantarella, the Bane.
A mysterious noblewoman, her beauty as captivating as it is perilous. She resides in a crown-like castle perched atop the mountain, where illusory dreams flow like streams, meticulously spun by her own hands.
new_translation_vi: Gia chủ hiện tại của <te href=850094>Fisalia</te>, Cantarella, Kẻ Gieo Rắc Tai Ương.

source_en:
The cauldron used by Cantarella, the Sea Witch, for potion brewing. The sapphire adorned on it marks Cantarella's authority as the head of the Fisalias.

She often allows her whims to guide her, carelessly tossing in unexpected ingredients, such as jellyfish tentacles, fish scales, tears from the heartbroken, and even the murmurs that linger in the air.

Whatever she adds, the result is always a pot of sweet dreams that dissolves the bitterness of reality, gently soothing those lost in the abyss.
new_translation_vi: Chiếc vạc được Cantarella, Phù thủy Biển, sử dụng để pha chế độc dược. Viên sapphire đính trên đó đánh dấu quyền uy của Cantarella với tư cách là gia chủ nhà Fisalia.

source_en:
The light filtered through the stained glass, casting a speckled pattern across the crimson sofa. 

Dim lamps flickered softly in the misty purple room. Around the round table sat several indistinct figures. Some lounging in the light, others half-immersed in the shadows. The lady who arranged this gathering, or at least, by her position, that's what it seemed, spoke first. She had long, silky purple hair, and her indigo eyes, veiled in a soft mist, gave her an ethereal, dreamlike vibe. Lounging lazily on the sofa, she absentmindedly toyed with the sapphire pendant on her chest, a habit she indulged whenever lost in thought.

"I've gathered everyone today to discuss one thing: where should we stay? In the '<te href=850119>Illusory Dream</te>,' or in reality?"

"Since we've been wandering the edge of dreams, should we remain here, in this illusion, where everything is familiar, light and delicate as bubbles? Or should we step forward, into reality, where we might face the unknown… but also see sights we've never known?"

A lazy but resolute voice cut through her words. "How weak of you, Cantarella. You may be head of the family now, but from what I see, you're far from being capable."

A figure emerged from the shadows, a woman with long hair cascading like a waterfall. She wore the same sapphire pendant and carried an air of grace similar to Cantarella's, but with the undeniable weight of experience and authority. Her deep purple eyes glinted with an unquestionable edge.

"This meeting is pointless. Just pour the '<te href=850120>Velvet Dream</te>' into the waterfall behind the castle, and let all of <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> fall into a dream under your control. That way, we will be queen wherever we go."

"Invalid answer. Or, if you insist, it will be counted as a vote for 'Illusory Dream.' Though it sounds a little wild and impractical, I'll still write it down for fairness. This is our discussion, after all." A young girl sitting beside them answered, opening a notebook full of strange doodles. She found a small space nearly buried under potion recipes and seriously drew a neat line.

"I abstain," she said casually. "This discussion probably won't change anything. You already have your answer, don't you? For me, it doesn't matter where we stay." She closed the notebook with a soft snap and shook out her white shawl. The light caught her blue, hazy eyes.

"Why can't we just keep it simple and follow our hearts? Cantarella, you like watching the birds outside the window and long for a life of freedom, right? Then just do what feels right," said the youngest one, sprawled on the sofa, her hands lazily chasing the dust motes dancing in the light.

"This is an important decision and should be discussed seriously," Cantarella replied, her voice tinged with a hint of helplessness. "Let's start with you then. Please explain your choice and the reasoning behind it."
new_translation_vi: Ánh sáng lọc qua những tấm kính màu, đổ bóng lốm đốm lên chiếc ghế sofa màu đỏ thẫm.

source_en:
The deep purple, venomous crown, when first placed upon the brow, brings a sharp sting. Yet, the blood that seeps from the forehead nourishes it, making it shine ever brighter. Soaked in the blood and tears of countless souls, this crown of toxic thorns rises from the depths of the sea,  symbolizing those who work silently against the chaos to support the weight of the Celestial Steed's tail feathers.

Such is the glory of the <te href=850094>Fisalia</te> family, and its inescapable fate.

But what of each member of the family? In the dark, deep sea, they suffer the gnawing whispers, until the faintest glimmer of true faith in their hearts fades, lost to the abyss. The next in line to wear the crown will take up the duty, and so the cycle endures, unbroken, with no beginning or end.

Fragrant yet toxic blooms,
Colorless, flavorless tears of poisons,
Twisted organs and venomous breaths,
Neurotoxins,
Biotoxins,
Metallic toxins…

The poisons and toxins the Fisalias so pride themselves on and the abilities birthed from them will inevitably be undone by the whispers… In the end, they only come in handy when used to seek the end of life, either for the Fisalias themselves or their kin.

This had long been the norm until I developed the "<te href=850119>Illusory Dream</te>." When the thorned crown burrowed into my flesh, the blood flew in strange, shimmering hues. Black tea steeped in mercury tasted like rich, honeyed nectar, while scones soaked in Jellyrose juice had a delicate sweetness. The heat in my throat was searing, as if hastily swallowing an entire cherry, and the suffocating sensation was like drifting in an endless sea… Slowly, the pain faded, and both body and mind became light as air. The bottles of poisons shattered on the floor, and our expressions turned relieved. The whispers were powerless in the world woven by the sea of dreams, for it gently dissolved all discord. Amidst the colorful waves, the once harsh thorned crown was softened… So soft that it formed delicate folds, resting lightly on my head. It became light and pure, like the tail feathers of the Celestial Steed.

That's why I cast my vote for "Illusory Dream." After all, what harm is there in this illusion? Have we not all wandered here for so long? Pour the "<te href=850120>Velvet Dream</te>" into the waterfall behind the castle, and let the whole of <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> fall into a dream shaped by my hand… Rest assured, this is but a joke. I do not seek to control but only wish for all to live more peacefully.

You see, the "Illusory Dream" flows within our veins, and whether we like it or not, it's a permanent and inseparable part of us.
new_translation_vi: Chiếc vương miện màu tím đậm, đầy nọc độc, khi lần đầu đặt lên trán, mang lại một cơn đau nhói. Tuy nhiên, dòng máu rỉ ra từ trán lại nuôi dưỡng nó, khiến nó tỏa sáng rực rỡ hơn bao giờ hết. Ngâm mình trong máu và nước mắt của vô số linh hồn, chiếc vương miện gai độc này trỗi dậy từ đáy biển sâu, tượng trưng cho những kẻ âm thầm làm việc chống lại sự hỗn loạn để gánh vác sức nặng từ những chiếc lông đuôi của Thiên Mã.

source_en:
In the dimly lit room, heavy with a peculiar scent, a faint yellow light illuminated an old notebook and a strange cauldron. The young woman, wrapped in a white shawl, scribbled notes in the book while casually tossing ingredients into the cauldron. The smoke rising from it darkened her clothes, leaving patches of black and purple. Her once-clean apron was now speckled, but she wiped her face carelessly, unfazed by the mess.

Distilled water, peppermint, castor bean, barnacle fish leaves, rosemary… The scent was fresh, the toxicity mild, with soothing and analgesic effects. It could treat the common Infantile Gray Matter syndrome seen recently… I'll write this recipe on a small note and leave it for Chloe later.

Hilo grass, sea okra, barnacle fish leaves, sea apple juice… The scent was unpleasant, and the toxicity potent, though it could counteract some nerve paralysis reactions. Hmm, but the side effects… Never mind, I'll keep it.

Sea okra mucilage, barnacle fish leaves dried and crushed, a splash of sea apple juice, a touch of Jellyrose juice… The toxicity of Jellyrose is too strong. Effective, but too risky.

Crush the barnacle fish leaves, drizzle with Violacas juice, mix with sea okra mucilage, add a bit of sea apple juice, and let it ferment in a glass vial… Done. Once consumed, it soothes the spirit and neutralizes most poison reactions. I should distribute some to everyone to get through the trials in the coming days. And the name… okay, I'll call it <te href=850120>Velvet Dream</te>.

The ingredients, processing method, sequence of preparation, and environmental temperature… Handle each step at the right moment, and I can brew the perfect elixir. I believe the same applies to life. At the right moment, with the right steps, most problems can be solved. No matter how illogical the rules or how brutal the situation is, there is always a way to find the right approach.

Therefore, I stepped into the darkness with the lamp, facing my fears. The abyss mocked me—reclusive, weak, incapable of adapting. Its taunting howls echoed through the corridors, the twisted frequencies of past family heads surging forward, engulfing me. Serious, rigid, pale, gloomy, silent… They knew me too well, able to predict my every move and trap me effortlessly.

But still, I played my very first and last trick as I drank a large dose of Velvet Dream in advance. The moment the jellyfish's poisonous thorns pierced my skin, I pressed the Jellyrose Medusa to my head. The violent toxins clashed within my veins, nearly tearing me apart. My soul rolled between life and death, on the verge of spilling out through my burning throat. I couldn't tell if it was blood, tears, or sweat mixed with the remnants of the potion… It dripped onto the almost extinguished lamp.

A small jellyfish wobbled out from the faint light. When I raised my eyes, the darkness lifted, and my blurred vision filled with colorful, vivid illusions.

It worked.

So, like I said, any situation can be solved with the right steps at the right time, even if you're just one part of the process. Since then, I've remained in a perpetual state between life and death, between dreams and reality. I often catch glimpses of lingering illusions, like the girl in the red hat. Who is she? Is it me? Or someone else? I can't figure it out.

Anyway, I'll abstain from voting. It doesn't matter whether it's in a dream or reality. I've been used to it, and I can survive anywhere.
new_translation_vi: Trong căn phòng mờ tối, nồng nặc một mùi hương kỳ lạ, một ánh sáng vàng nhạt chiếu rọi cuốn sổ tay cũ và một chiếc vạc kỳ lạ. Người phụ nữ trẻ, khoác trên mình chiếc khăn choàng trắng, nguệch ngoạc ghi chú vào cuốn sổ trong khi thản nhiên ném các nguyên liệu vào vạc. Khói bốc lên từ đó làm sẫm màu quần áo cô, để lại những mảng đen và tím. Chiếc tạp dề từng sạch sẽ giờ đã lấm lem, nhưng cô lau mặt một cách bất cẩn, không hề bận tâm đến sự bừa bộn.

source_en: Since I could remember, I had always been in that big, empty house. I would walk from one end to the other, knowing every tile on the floor and every potion bottle on the shelves. The house was gray, dark, and quiet. The only time it ever felt alive was when a bird flew past the window. I would watch its white wings flutter up and down until it became nothing more than a tiny dot in the sky. Beyond that, the sky turned a clear blue, and the trees shone a bright green. It was such a beautiful sight. That was when I would wonder… what was happening in that thick forest? Maybe a princess was having an adventure. I imagined a clever princess who knew how to spot a poisoned apple. When a snake chased her, a little bird would swoop in to save her, carrying her high into the sky. There, she would find a girl in red shoes who couldn't stop dancing and save her. Then, they would dive into the sea to rescue a siren who was on the verge of turning into foam. In the end, the bird would carry them all, flying as far as it could until it could fly no more, finally landing in a castle… But what was the castle like? I only hoped it wasn't like the manor I lived in—big and boring. Sorry, that probably sounds all over the place, doesn't it? Well… Mother and Father always said that girls from the Fisalia family didn't need to read silly fairytales or have strange ideas like that. We were supposed to read books—books like The Complete Guide to Poison Recipes, The Fisalia Family's Secret Elixirs, and 108 Poisons You Never Knew About. They were interesting, but after reading them too many times, they became dull. Still, Mother and Father insisted that I memorize everything so that one day, I could save myself, or perhaps even become a Maiden or the family's leader. It sounded like a huge responsibility. I didn't really understand it yet, but I did what they told me. They were always busy, always rushing around. Whenever they left, they locked the door extra tight and checked it over and over again. I never understood why they grew busier and thinner. And why did they drink so much "water" and mumble strange words? I had learned to say those words too: "It's the glory and fate of the Fisalias." Eventually, I grew older and had to move to a different house. When I left, Mother and Father looked proud, but their eyes were full of tears. "Indeed, milord, our child has great talent, especially in brewing poisons." "Yes, becoming a candidate for the trials is the glory and fate of the Fisalias." That was the first time I ever left home. As I stepped outside, my footsteps startled the crows perched on the dead tree near the gate. They flapped their black wings and took off, flying toward a strange castle in the distance. Oh, sorry, I went off track again. What I meant to say was... after spending so long flying through dreams, you start to miss the feeling of your feet on the ground. Sure, you might step into mud or get pricked by sharp stones, but there was something comforting about taking each step on solid earth. So, when it came time to vote, I chose reality—The Other Side of the Dream, as the adults liked to call it. They always used fancy terms like that. But deep down, you already knew what your heart truly wanted, didn't you? Not just in dreams, but in reality, too. You could open the door, step outside, and go with everyone. Just fly alongside the white birds and chase after the happily-ever-after ending for everyone.
new_translation_vi: Kể từ khi còn nhớ được, tôi đã luôn ở trong ngôi nhà lớn, trống rỗng đó. Tôi sẽ đi từ đầu này đến đầu kia, biết rõ từng viên gạch trên sàn và từng chai độc dược trên kệ. Ngôi nhà xám xịt, tối tăm và yên tĩnh. Lần duy nhất nó cảm thấy có sức sống là khi một chú chim bay ngang qua cửa sổ. Tôi sẽ nhìn đôi cánh trắng của nó đập lên đập xuống cho đến khi nó chỉ còn là một chấm nhỏ trên bầu trời. Ngoài kia, bầu trời chuyển sang màu xanh trong vắt, và những cái cây tỏa sáng màu xanh tươi. Đó là một cảnh tượng thật đẹp.

source_en: Tell me, what do you suppose goes into the <te href=850094>Fisalia</te> family's famed elixir? A rare herb, grown in secret? Tormented souls simmering in unseen cauldrons? Hehe... Or perhaps the delicate flesh of young girls?
new_translation_vi: Nói cho tôi biết, bạn cho rằng thứ gì tạo nên loại thuốc tiên nổi tiếng của gia tộc <te href=850094>Fisalia</te>? Một loại thảo mộc quý hiếm, được trồng trong bí mật? Những linh hồn đau khổ đang sôi sục trong những chiếc vạc không ai thấy? Hehe… Hay có lẽ là da thịt tinh tế của những cô gái trẻ?

source_en: Even in shackles, she dances elegantly—a true <te href=850101>Montelli</te>, yet more than that. Where will her choices lead her family? How delightful to imagine how she might present herself when next we meet.
new_translation_vi: Ngay cả trong xiềng xích, cô ấy vẫn nhảy múa một cách thanh lịch—một <te href=850101>Montelli</te> thực thụ, nhưng còn hơn thế nữa. Những lựa chọn của cô ấy sẽ dẫn dắt gia tộc mình đi về đâu? Thật thú vị khi tưởng tượng cô ấy sẽ thể hiện mình như thế nào trong lần gặp tới.

source_en: She accomplished the impossible, reclaiming her humanity from the cage of a Divinity's vessel. When the Carnevale petals fall upon <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>'s streets again, the Holy Maiden will at last be herself.
new_translation_vi: Cô ấy đã hoàn thành điều không thể, giành lại nhân tính từ chiếc lồng của vật chứa Thần linh. Khi những cánh hoa Carnevale rơi xuống đường phố <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> một lần nữa, Thánh Nữ cuối cùng cũng sẽ là chính mình.

source_en: The current head of <te href=850094>Fisalia</te>, Cantarella, the Bane. Whether I am the Bane of the wicked or the pure is yours to decide. Shh, no need to answer. The moment you arrived, the ripples that surrounded you told me all I needed to know.
new_translation_vi: Gia chủ hiện tại của <te href=850094>Fisalia</te>, Cantarella, Kẻ Gieo Rắc Tai Ương. Liệu tôi là Tai Ương của kẻ ác hay của người thuần khiết là tùy bạn quyết định. Suỵt, không cần trả lời đâu. Khoảnh khắc bạn đến, những gợn sóng xung quanh bạn đã cho tôi biết tất cả những gì tôi cần biết.

source_en: Can I mix you a jug of Violaca juice? It soothes nerves and eases fatigue. You must learn to relax. You can't help others if you don't take care of yourself, you know.
new_translation_vi: Tôi có thể pha cho bạn một bình nước ép Violaca không? Nó làm dịu thần kinh và giảm mệt mỏi. Bạn phải học cách thư giãn. Bạn không thể giúp đỡ người khác nếu không tự chăm sóc bản thân, bạn biết đấy.

source_en: Aren't these jellyfish beautiful? Come, try touching one... a light caress. There, there, you needn't be afraid. I would never put you in harm's way. See, they only wish to wrap their soft tendrils around your finger and pull you into a sweet, sweet dream.
new_translation_vi: Những chú sứa này không đẹp sao? Lại đây, thử chạm vào một con xem… một cái vuốt ve nhẹ nhàng. Nào, nào, bạn không cần phải sợ. Tôi sẽ không bao giờ làm hại bạn đâu. Thấy không, chúng chỉ muốn quấn những xúc tu mềm mại quanh ngón tay bạn và kéo bạn vào một giấc mơ ngọt ngào, ngọt ngào.

source_en: Some see in dreams the scars of a troubled past, others see bleak futures. For those confined in reality, dreams offer a sweet reprieve. Tell me, what do you see in yours, if not nothing at all? Look at you, hehe... so peacefully asleep.
new_translation_vi: Một số người nhìn thấy trong giấc mơ những vết sẹo của quá khứ đầy rắc rối, những người khác lại thấy những tương lai ảm đạm. Đối với những kẻ bị giam cầm trong thực tại, giấc mơ mang đến một sự giải thoát ngọt ngào. Nói cho tôi biết, bạn thấy gì trong giấc mơ của mình, nếu không phải là hư vô? Nhìn bạn kìa, hehe… đang ngủ thật yên bình.

source_en: Dreams born of fevered escape lay bare our darkest desires and fears. The weak drown in their own fantasies until they fade into oblivion. But I know that's not you. You sip the poison like it's sweet nectar.
new_translation_vi: Những giấc mơ sinh ra từ sự trốn chạy đầy sốt sắng phơi bày những ham muốn và nỗi sợ hãi đen tối nhất của chúng ta. Kẻ yếu đuối chết chìm trong những ảo tưởng của chính mình cho đến khi tan biến vào hư vô. Nhưng tôi biết đó không phải là bạn. Bạn nhấp poison như thể đó là mật ngọt.

source_en: You see those delicate blooms in the garden? I shall pluck them and distill their essence into sweet concoctions. The toxins in their petals, once crushed, will be tempered, the poison dissolving like a fading nightmare leaving only a soft fragrance that beckons sweet dreams.
new_translation_vi: Bạn thấy những đóa hoa tinh tế trong vườn kia không? Tôi sẽ hái chúng và chưng cất tinh chất của chúng thành những hỗn hợp ngọt ngào. Độc tố trong cánh hoa của chúng, khi bị nghiền nát, sẽ được tôi luyện, poison tan biến như một cơn ác mộng phai nhạt chỉ để lại một hương thơm dịu nhẹ mời gọi những giấc mơ ngọt ngào.

source_en: Perhaps you've heard of this method for crafting poison? Seal venomous creatures in a jar, and let them battle until only one remains... Nourished by the venom of the dead, it will produce the deadliest poison, the vilest of all banes.
new_translation_vi: Có lẽ bạn đã nghe nói về phương pháp chế tạo poison này? Nhốt những sinh vật độc hại vào một cái lọ, và để chúng chiến đấu cho đến khi chỉ còn một con sống sót… Được nuôi dưỡng bởi nọc độc của kẻ chết, nó sẽ tạo ra loại poison chết chóc nhất, loại tai ương đê tiện nhất trong tất cả.

source_en: The little girl with a giant box who plays with fireworks? A fascinating child. I wonder if bringing her into this castle would liven it up a little. Oh relax, I'm only teasing.
new_translation_vi: Cô bé với chiếc hộp khổng lồ chơi đùa với pháo hoa ấy sao? Một đứa trẻ hấp dẫn. Tôi tự hỏi liệu đưa cô bé vào lâu đài này có làm nó sống động hơn một chút không. Ồ thư giãn đi, tôi chỉ đùa thôi.

source_en: Hmm, what would be a fitting analogy... perhaps an immortal jellyfish? Like these delicate, shimmering creatures roving alone in the darkness, {Male=he;Female=she} dispels shadows with {Male=his;Female=her} gentle light, inch by inch, until the end of time.
new_translation_vi: Hmm, một sự so sánh phù hợp sẽ là gì… có lẽ là một con sứa bất tử? Giống như những sinh vật tinh tế, lung linh này lang thang một mình trong bóng tối, {Male=anh ấy;Female=cô ấy} xua tan bóng tối bằng ánh sáng dịu dàng của {Male=mình;Female=mình}, từng chút một, cho đến tận cùng thời gian.

source_en: Fine black pearl powder, the essence of Albizia flowers, and the petals of starfish blooms, all sealed in a glass vial bearing your name. For all the time we've shared, it has slowly fermented, ripening to perfection. Today, the moment has finally come. Unseal this birthday elixir, and look... Do you see? A fleeting moment in your long life, a private stretch of sea that belongs to only the two of us.
new_translation_vi: Bột ngọc trai đen mịn, tinh chất hoa Albizia, và những cánh hoa sao biển, tất cả được niêm phong trong một lọ thủy tinh mang tên bạn. Trong suốt thời gian chúng ta chia sẻ, nó đã lên men chậm rãi, chín muồi đến mức hoàn hảo. Hôm nay, khoảnh khắc đó cuối cùng đã đến. Hãy mở loại thuốc tiên sinh nhật này ra, và nhìn xem… Bạn có thấy không? Một khoảnh khắc thoáng qua trong cuộc đời dài của bạn, một vùng biển riêng tư chỉ thuộc về hai chúng ta.

source_en: Who can plumb the sea's depths, or uncover its secrets? Yet for those who brave its dark currents, the sea offers her truest, most tender gifts—her treasures, her deepest secret.
new_translation_vi: Ai có thể đo lường độ sâu của biển cả, hay khám phá những bí mật của nó? Tuy nhiên, đối với những kẻ dũng cảm đối mặt với những dòng chảy đen tối của nó, biển cả mang đến những món quà chân thật, dịu dàng nhất—những kho báu của nó, bí mật sâu kín nhất của nó.

source_en: You rose from the ocean in the sky, wove through loops of time, and now you've reached the sea's depths. Remember, no matter how venomous the seabed, there will always be a place for you here. Here, the currents move slowly, and I long to... drift with you.
new_translation_vi: Bạn trỗi dậy từ đại dương trên bầu trời, len lỏi qua những vòng lặp thời gian, và giờ bạn đã chạm đến độ sâu của biển cả. Hãy nhớ rằng, dù đáy biển có độc hại đến đâu, sẽ luôn có một nơi dành cho bạn ở đây. Ở đây, những dòng chảy di chuyển chậm rãi, và tôi khao khát… được trôi dạt cùng bạn.

source_en: This is a testament to my connection with the world around me, and it's very much my companion now, bearing witness to everything I've experienced on this journey.
new_translation_vi: Đây là minh chứng cho sự kết nối của tôi với thế giới xung quanh, và giờ nó thực sự là người bạn đồng hành của tôi, chứng kiến mọi thứ tôi đã trải qua trên hành trình này.

source_en: This is a testament to my connection with the world around me, and it's very much my companion now, bearing witness to everything I've experienced on this journey.
new_translation_vi: Đây là minh chứng cho sự kết nối của tôi với thế giới xung quanh,

source_en: No. Normally, you can't perceive the frequencies in a melody, but that manuscript lets you see the world as I do. That part with the Daemons... should be right here.
new_translation_vi: No. Normally, you can't perceive the frequencies in a melody, but that manuscript lets you see the world as I do. That part with the Daemons... should be right here.

source_en:
???: They burned in despair, resentful of the Order's verdict till their last breath. Their last work is nothing but a curse upon us all!
{PlayerName}: It's the same as what we heard before, but now I see something. A balance scale, with a crowd of people standing on one of the pans. What are they weighing?
Ciaccona: The two sides of the scale represent differing perspectives. Once a work is made public, its meaning no longer belongs to its creator alone, but is shaped by the interpretations of its readers.
new_translation_vi:
???: They burned in despair, resentful of the Order's verdict till their last breath. Their last work is nothing but a curse upon us all!
{PlayerName}: It's the same as what we heard before, but now I see something. A balance scale, with a crowd of people standing on one of the pans. What are they weighing?
Ciaccona: The two sides of the scale represent differing perspectives. Once a work is made public, its meaning no longer belongs to its creator alone, but is shaped by the interpretations of its readers.

source_en:
Perhaps it was a simple poem at first, nothing more. But then that article claimed it was a curse upon Ragunna.
Given that members of the Golden Anthem were banished on the Pilgrim's Sail and died in a fire, the notion quickly took hold.
new_translation_vi:
Perhaps it was a simple poem at first, nothing more. But then that article claimed it was a curse upon Ragunna.
Given that members of the Golden Anthem were banished on the Pilgrim's Sail and died in a fire, the notion quickly took hold.

source_en:
No one knew exactly what happened, so they filled in the gaps with their imaginations. With motive and a complete story, perhaps that's all it took for a lie to become the truth.
"Each time someone plays their last work, it summons Daemons. This is the Golden Anthem's revenge and curse upon Ragunna."
But still, words and imagination alone cannot bring something into existence...
new_translation_vi:
No one knew exactly what happened, so they filled in the gaps with their imaginations. With motive and a complete story, perhaps that's all it took for a lie to become the truth.
"Each time someone plays their last work, it summons Daemons. This is the Golden Anthem's revenge and curse upon Ragunna."
But still, words and imagination alone cannot bring something into existence...

source_en:
If the Daemons are born from the public's imagination, then things will shift once we catch whoever is responsible for starting this in the first place. 
This mastermind has gone to great lengths to twist the facts, stirring fear and turning it into resentment. It may be an attempt to cover up certain stories about the Poets Society.
He must be tied to them somehow. If we can learn more about the Golden Anthem, we might be one step closer to catching him.
new_translation_vi:
If the Daemons are born from the public's imagination, then things will shift once we catch whoever is responsible for starting this in the first place. 
This mastermind has gone to great lengths to twist the facts, stirring fear and turning it into resentment. It may be an attempt to cover up certain stories about the Poets Society.
He must be tied to them somehow. If we can learn more about the Golden Anthem, we might be one step closer to catching him.

source_en: {PlayerName}: This is... a cathedral. That's the choir on stage, with the Poets Society leading them. Looks like it's a ceremony of some kind. It sounds like...
new_translation_vi: {PlayerName}: This is... a cathedral. That's the choir on stage, with the Poets Society leading them. Looks like it's a ceremony of some kind. It sounds like...

source_en:
Angry Listener: Degenerates! Arrogant hypocrites, every last one of you! You have no idea what happened... none at all!
Angry Listener: Has the Order reduced our sacrifices to mere tales to be told over tea? The Sentinel's blessing. Bah!
Angry Listener: Where were you when we fought the Tacet Discords at Whisperwind Haven? Where were any of you? Where was the Sentinel?!
Angry Listener: We didn't fight for the Sentinel or for the damned Order. We fought for ourselves! You're nothing but hypocrites!
new_translation_vi:
Angry Listener: Đồ thoái hóa! Đồ đạo đức giả kiêu ngạo, tất cả bọn ngươi! Mấy người có biết chuyện gì đã xảy ra không... chẳng biết gì cả!
Angry Listener: Liệu Hội đã biến những hy sinh của chúng ta thành những câu chuyện kể bên tách trà sao? Phước lành của Sentinel. Thật nực cười!
Angry Listener: Các người đã ở đâu khi chúng ta chiến đấu với lũ Tacet Discord tại Whisperwind Haven? Các người đã ở đâu? Sentinel đã ở đâu?!
Angry Listener: Chúng ta không chiến đấu vì Sentinel hay cái Giáo Đoàn chết tiệt ấy. Chúng ta chiến đấu vì chính mình! Đồ đạo đức giả!

source_en:
Master of Ceremony: This is madness! Who is this madman? Someone remove him from here, immediately!
Master of Ceremony: Do not be deceived! All knights who rode into that battle wielded swords sanctified by the Order. They fought in the name of Divinity!
new_translation_vi:
Master of Ceremony: This is madness! Who is this madman? Someone remove him from here, immediately!
Master of Ceremony: Do not be deceived! All knights who rode into that battle wielded swords sanctified by the Order. They fought in the name of Divinity!

source_en:
"Girl in the Study": Afternoon tea! Yes, please!
Maid: Your tea and biscuits, miss. I'll reapply the medicine once you're finished. Next time, no more climbing walls, understood?
"Girl in the Study": It wasn't just for fun, I was trying to—
new_translation_vi:
"Girl in the Study": Afternoon tea! Yes, please!
Maid: Your tea and biscuits, miss. I'll reapply the medicine once you're finished. Tiếp time, no more climbing walls, understood?
"Girl in the Study": It wasn't just for fun, I was trying to—

source_en:
Maid: There, there. I understand you've always been a curious child. You saw something terribly interesting and snuck out to take a closer look. 
"Girl in the Study": Mmmff... Wait, wait! Is it raspberry? My favorite. Huh? Ah... Oww, oww, oww!
new_translation_vi:
Maid: There, there. I understand you've always been a curious child. You saw something terribly interesting and snuck out to take a closer look. 
"Girl in the Study": Mmmff... Wait, wait! Is it raspberry? My favorite. Huh? Ah... Oww, oww, oww!

source_en: "Girl in the Study": Look at this! This book says the flower doesn't live long, but that's silly. I know it can survive the coldest of winters! "Girl in the Study": Maybe one day, I'll become a great bard. A proper one, who never makes mistakes like this!
new_translation_vi: "Girl in the Study": Look at this! This book says the flower doesn't live long, but that's silly. I know it can survive the coldest of winters! "Girl in the Study": Maybe one day, I'll become a great bard. A proper one, who never makes mistakes like this!

source_en:
Maid: Miss, this study is a secret... You must never tell a soul.
"Girl in the Study": I understand, but I've always wondered... why do people say they're guilty? There are so many interesting poems and songs here. Why won't Father let me see them?
Maid: Oh, you'll understand when you're older, Miss...
new_translation_vi:
Maid: Miss, this study is a secret... You must never tell a soul.
"Girl in the Study": I understand, but I've always wondered... why do people say they're guilty? There are so many interesting poems and songs here. Why won't Father let me see them?
Maid: Oh, you'll understand when you're older, Miss...

source_en:
The poets did board the Pilgrim's Sail, becoming the stars of their own final act.
We all know how that tale ended—a great fire consumed the ship, dragging it to icy depths, and the poets of the Golden Anthem with it.
But hear this, banishment did not breed hatred in their hearts for our city, and the flames did not scorch a curse into their music or poems.
new_translation_vi:
The poets did board the Pilgrim's Sail, becoming the stars of their own final act.
We all know how that tale ended—a great fire consumed the ship, dragging it to icy depths, and the poets of the Golden Anthem with it.
But hear this, banishment did not breed hatred in their hearts for our city, and the flames did not scorch a curse into their music or poems.

source_en:
If you wish to hear their true voices once more, seek them at the Cathedral of Mercury.
The children there still sing hymns written by the poets of the Golden Anthem, and yet... not a single Daemon has appeared.
Even as those poets faced their end—
new_translation_vi:
If you wish to hear their true voices once more, seek them at the Cathedral of Mercury.
The children there still sing hymns written by the poets of the Golden Anthem, and yet... not a single Daemon has appeared.
Even as those poets faced their end—

source_en:
As the fire filled the ship's cabins, they penned their last poems with death drawing near.
Perhaps they were greeted by the Sentinel in their final moments, or perhaps they fell silently toward death...
new_translation_vi:
As the fire filled the ship's cabins, they penned their last poems with death drawing near.
Perhaps they were greeted by the Sentinel in their final moments, or perhaps they fell silently toward death...

source_en:
If the poets truly meant to curse Ragunna, why would they write such obscure poems?
Why not simply leave their works behind in Ragunna? No, their last words were hastily written as the flames closed in.
new_translation_vi:
If the poets truly meant to curse Ragunna, why would they write such obscure poems?
Why not simply leave their works behind in Ragunna? No, their last words were hastily written as the flames closed in.

source_en:
This is how it all started. A mysterious person showed the poets the truth about the Sentinel. Then they decided to become Knights of Ragunna. 
Back then, besides the conductor, there were others who helped organize things. That was us, the Toccata family.
new_translation_vi:
This is how it all started. A mysterious person showed the poets the truth about the Sentinel. Then they decided to become Knights of Ragunna. 
Quay lại then, besides the conductor, there were others who helped organize things. That was us, the Toccata family.

source_en:
It didn't take long for the Order to notice us. To keep everyone safe, they gave my father a key to a study. 
Inside, there were papers that could've destroyed the Order... if anyone would even believe them in the first place.  
It was blasphemy... but my father didn't hesitate. He took the key right away.
new_translation_vi:
It didn't take long for the Order to notice us. To keep everyone safe, they gave my father a key to a study. 
Inside, there were papers that could've destroyed the Order... if anyone would even believe them in the first place.  
It was blasphemy... but my father didn't hesitate. He took the key right away.

source_en: Usually, the food and water on those ships aren't enough to get the people where they need to go. Even if they made it, the cold would get them. But on that ship, the Order made sure there was nothing. No food, no water, nothing. And there were only three "Fools" onboard.
new_translation_vi: Usually, the food and water on those ships aren't enough to get the people where they need to go. Even if they made it, the cold would get them. But on that ship, the Order made sure there was nothing. No food, no water, nothing. And there were only three "Fools" onboard.

source_en:
In the past, everyone thought they were brilliant cantors. But inside, only they understood how fake and arrogant all their poems and music really were. 
In their last moments before death, the poets just wanted to leave something real behind. But it was so cold out at sea, and wood for fire was already running low...
So they set the cabin on fire and met their ends in the flames.
new_translation_vi:
In the past, everyone thought they were brilliant cantors. But inside, only they understood how fake and arrogant all their poems and music really were. 
In their last moments before death, the poets just wanted to leave something real behind. But it was so cold out at sea, and wood for fire was already running low...
So they set the cabin on fire and met their ends in the flames.

source_en:
In the world they dreamed of, poets would no longer be shackled and everyone could sing freely. That was their wish for the future when the curtain fell.
"With our bodies to fuel the fire, the ensuing inferno shall forge Ragunna's true gold."
new_translation_vi:
In the world they dreamed of, poets would no longer be shackled and everyone could sing freely. That was their wish for the future when the curtain fell.
"With our bodies to fuel the fire, the ensuing inferno shall forge Ragunna's true gold."

source_en:
The Golden Anthem gave my father the key. At first, he wouldn't let me near it because I was too little.
It wasn't until my mother, my uncle, and the rest of my family were one by one escorted onto Pilgrim's Sails... Then, it was his turn.
new_translation_vi:
The Golden Anthem gave my father the key. At first, he wouldn't let me near it because I was too little.
It wasn't until my mother, my uncle, and the rest of my family were one by one escorted onto Pilgrim's Sails... Then, it was his turn.

source_en: Don't see it as a burden, my child. Remember, true courage isn't hiding it away in your heart. Raise it like a torch, just like the sun, so it can light the way for others.
new_translation_vi: Don't see it as a burden, my child. Remember, true courage isn't hiding it away in your heart. Raise it like a torch, just like the sun, so it can light the way for others.

source_en:
Father wanted to tell everyone, so the Order put him on a Pilgrim's Sail with the same charges. And... that was the last time I saw him.
Later, after I became a wandering bard and poet, I started to feel what was in the melodies of the poets and my ancestors... A sincerity like none other.
new_translation_vi:
Father wanted to tell everyone, so the Order put him on a Pilgrim's Sail with the same charges. And... that was the last time I saw him.
Later, after I became a wandering bard and poet, I started to feel what was in the melodies of the poets and my ancestors... A sincerity like none other.

source_en:
The Poets Society and our family could never prove whether the Sentinel's form is really that of a Celestial Steed.
All we could do was hold onto our suspicions and the possible truth... waiting for someone to prove it.
Now... that someone has come. {Male=He;Female=She} has reached the inverted tower.
new_translation_vi:
The Poets Society and our family could never prove whether the Sentinel's form is really that of a Celestial Steed.
All we could do was hold onto our suspicions and the possible truth... waiting for someone to prove it.
Now... that someone has come. {Male=He;Female=She} has reached the inverted tower.

source_en:
Now, I have that choice again—Do I reveal the truth?
Always worrying about my next meal, wandering from place to place, being chased by Acolytes... I'm used to it.
new_translation_vi:
Now, I have that choice again—Do I reveal the truth?
Always worrying about my next meal, wandering from place to place, being chased by Acolytes... I'm used to it.

source_en:
But this time, I have you and my friends with me... I can't let you all repeat my fate. 
If we step onto that stage tomorrow, the Order will not stand idly by. They might even come after you and Carlotta...
new_translation_vi:
But this time, I have you and my friends with me... I can't let you all repeat my fate. 
If we step onto that stage tomorrow, the Order will not stand idly by. They might even come after you and Carlotta...

source_en: {PlayerName}: Like I said, the truth exists to be uncovered. I've made my choice. And once everyone hears the truth, I believe no one will question the choices you all made in the past.
new_translation_vi: {PlayerName}: Like I said, the truth exists to be uncovered. I've made my choice. And once everyone hears the truth, I believe no one will question the choices you all made in the past.

source_en:
Maybe because you went to Avinoleum and uncovered some of the truths the Order is desperate to hide... 
It will take a lot more than that to even leave a scratch on you. Perhaps they're having someone else do their dirty work. 
That just makes finding the one pulling the strings a top priority...
new_translation_vi:
Maybe because you went to Avinoleum and uncovered some of the truths the Order is desperate to hide... 
It will take a lot more than that to even leave a scratch on you. Perhaps they're having someone else do their dirty work. 
That just makes finding the one pulling the strings a top priority...

source_en:
Banished and forever stripped of the right to sing for the Sentinel and the Order... that much is true. 
The Order's records say as much. But there's still... something missing. 
If such an important melody is lost, we won't be able to find the link between the poets and the Order...
new_translation_vi:
Banished and forever stripped of the right to sing for the Sentinel and the Order... that much is true. 
The Order's records say as much. But there's still... something missing. 
If such an important melody is lost, we won't be able to find the link between the poets and the Order...

source_en:
On the surface, yes, the Order certainly upheld Ragunna's prosperity and stability…
The poets, praised for their songs to honor the Sentinel, earned the Order's favor. Despite their banishment, their works still serve the Order's cause today.
But this, my friend, doesn't strike the right chord we need to follow...
new_translation_vi: Xét trên bề mặt, đúng là Order đã duy trì sự thịnh vượng và ổn định của Ragunna…

source_en:
That doesn't quite add up. 
If hellfire was all that remained from the Pilgrim's Sail, then... could they really have been trying to curse Ragunna?
If that were the case... well, shouldn't the curse have come true?
new_translation_vi: Điều đó không hợp lý chút nào.

source_en:
That's an awfully big assumption! What if they never boarded the Pilgrim's Sail at all? What if none of them perished in that fire? 
That begs the question, who was on that ship? Who started the fire and spread the rumors about the Golden Anthem?
new_translation_vi: Đó là một giả định quá lớn! Nếu họ chưa bao giờ đặt chân lên Pilgrim's Sail thì sao? Nếu không ai trong số họ thiệt mạng trong vụ hỏa hoạn đó thì sao?

source_en:
Another poet intimately familiar with the poets of the Golden Anthem, you say? 
If such a person exists, then why haven't the Golden Anthem stepped forward to prove their innocence?
No... That's not it. This will take the story in the wrong direction...
new_translation_vi: Bạn nói là còn một nhà thơ khác rất thân thiết với các nhà thơ của Golden Anthem ư?

source_en:
No, it was the Order and others who "cursed" their works, then deliberately spread them as "forbidden works" to the public... 
But why? If their aim was to silence you for knowing the truth about the Blessed Maiden and Imperator, it was a clumsy attempt.
new_translation_vi: Không, chính Order và những kẻ khác đã "nguyền rủa" tác phẩm của họ, rồi cố tình lan truyền chúng như những "tác phẩm cấm" đến công chúng...

source_en:
Monsters breed fear, and perhaps fear is exactly what the Order of the Deep and this puppet master want to see.
It seems we've become pawns in Fenrico and this puppet master's game...
The more I think about it... we, too, have become the very ones to curse Rinascita...
new_translation_vi: Quái vật sinh ra nỗi sợ hãi, và có lẽ nỗi sợ hãi chính là thứ mà Order of the Deep cùng kẻ giật dây này muốn thấy.

source_en:
Our crime was the same as the poets. "Blasphemy." 
Our family wasn't like the Fisalias, deeply rooted in tradition, nor were we like the Montellis, wielding power. We simply did what we thought was right, preserving everything for those who would come after us.
new_translation_vi: Tội lỗi của chúng ta cũng giống như các nhà thơ. "Báng bổ."

source_en:
Compared to the Order, we were just a tiny speck of dust. Even if we'd kept the secret, they would've discovered it eventually. 
They would seize what the poets left behind and lock it away.
new_translation_vi: So với Order, chúng ta chỉ là một hạt bụi nhỏ bé. Ngay cả khi chúng ta giữ kín bí mật, cuối cùng họ cũng sẽ phát hiện ra thôi.

source_en:
Maybe, if Father hadn't taken in the poets' legacy, the Toccata family would've escaped this fate.
Perhaps none of this would've happened... 
If so, wouldn't it have been wiser to surrender it all to the Order back then?
new_translation_vi: Có lẽ, nếu cha không tiếp nhận di sản của các nhà thơ, gia tộc Toccata đã có thể tránh được số phận này.

source_en:
The fate of the Toccata family might've taken a different turn. 
But when you face the Order of the Deep and their false Divinity... our fate is no longer ours to control.
new_translation_vi: Số phận của gia tộc Toccata có lẽ đã rẽ sang một hướng khác.
